### [1] [PragyaDoc: A Universal Document Intelligence Framework for Multilingual Medical Document Understanding in Low-Resource Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07478)
*Jagpal Singh Jhala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PragyaDoc是一个通用文档智能框架，通过四层流水线（并行集成OCR提取、几何-词汇融合、确定性领域结构化、双LLM医学推理与本地化）解决印度22种官方语言下医疗文档仅以英文存在、乡村患者及社区工作者无法理解的核心语言可及性障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 印度拥有22种官方语言，但绝大多数医疗文档仅以英文存在，而最需要这些信息的群体——乡村人口、ASHA工作者和患者家属——被功能性排除在理解范围之外，形成了严重的信息可及性鸿沟。

Method: 提出四层流水线框架：（1）并行集成OCR提取层，融合多个OCR引擎提升文字识别鲁棒性；（2）几何-词汇融合层，整合文档空间布局与语义词汇信息；（3）确定性领域结构化层，基于规则对医学文档进行确定性结构化处理；（4）双LLM医学推理与本地化层，利用两个大语言模型协同完成医学推理和多语言本地化。

Result: 论文通过PragyaDoc框架展示了跨语言医疗文档智能理解的可行方案，弥合了英文医疗文档与多语言印度患者群体之间的信息鸿沟。

Conclusion: PragyaDoc通过多层次架构有效解决了印度多语言环境下医疗文档的可访问性问题，为类似多语言、低资源地区的医疗信息普及提供了可扩展的技术范式。

Abstract: India's 22 official languages create a critical accessibility barrier: the majority of medical documentation exists exclusively in English, yet the patients who most urgently require this information - rural populations, ASHA workers, and patient families - are functionally excluded from understanding it. This paper presents PragyaDoc, a Universal Document Intelligence Framework that addresses this gap through a four-layer pipeline: a parallel ensemble OCR extraction layer, a geometric-lexical fusion layer, a deterministic domain structuring layer, and a dual-LLM medical reasoning and localization layer

</details>


### [2] [NeuroPilot: An Agent-Driven Smart Pipeline for Processing, Quality Control, and Managing Neuroimages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07541)
*Yiyao Chen,Yucheng Li,Jungong Tong,Shaoqi Wang,Kunhao Zhou,Ziquan Wei,Monica Murea,Marissa DiPiero,Tingting Dan,Guorong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NeuroPilot是一个多智能体系统，利用三个LLM可调用的技能（dcm2bids-skill、neuroimage-pre-skill、qc-agent-skill）自动编排神经图像处理工作流，涵盖数据标准化、模态特定预处理和质量控制三个阶段，已在17个队列（>123,000名受试者）中部署，将传统2-3个月的处理时间压缩至一周。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经影像数据从原始档案转化为可用于分析的衍生数据依赖三个脆弱的阶段：数据标准化、模态特定预处理和质量控制。尽管单个工具已发展成熟，但其编排需要项目特定脚本、环境自适应调优和劳动密集型的人工QC，缺乏自动化和可扩展性。

Method: NeuroPilot采用多智能体架构，将神经影像处理、QC和数据管理的专业知识数字化为三个LLM可调用的技能模块。LLM驱动的智能体自动编排工作流，将各种基础设施设置泛化为单一配置。系统通过dcm2bids-skill标准化数据后，根据可用模态和队列特征动态路由至最优预处理管线（如fMRIPrep或婴儿专用管线），随后qc-agent-skill通过3D浏览器仪表盘驱动基于证据的半自动QC，采用多层级验证系统处理失败病例。

Result: 神经Pilot在17个队列（>123,000名受试者）中部署，覆盖从婴儿到老年人群及多种MRI模态（结构、扩散、功能）。QC智能体筛查了558名生产受试者，验证了其自动标记与FreeSurfer拓扑缺陷指标的一致性。婴儿处理流程在QC验证输入上实现了100%（201/201）的完成率。系统将传统2-3个月的人员培训和完整数据处理时间压缩至一周。

Conclusion: NeuroPilot通过LLM驱动的多智能体编排成功实现了神经影像处理流程的自动化和泛化，在大规模多队列场景中展现出高可扩展性和可靠性，显著缩短了处理周期并减少了人工QC负担。

Abstract: Transforming raw neuroimage archives into analysis-ready derivatives relies on three brittle stages: data standardization, modality-specific preprocessing, and quality control (QC). While individual neuroimaging tools are well developed, their orchestration requires project-specific scripts, environment-adaptive tuning, and labor-intensive manual QC. To address this, we introduce NeuroPilot, a multi-agent system that digitalizes the expertise of neuroimage processing, QC, and data management into three LLM-invocable skills: dcm2bids-skill, neuroimage-pre-skill, and qc-agent-skill. The LLM-driven agent autonomously orchestrates workflows, generalizing various infrastructure settings into a single configuration to achieve the highest scalability. Demonstrating the system's generalizability, we deployed NeuroPilot across 17 cohorts (>123,000 subjects) spanning infant to aging populations and multiple MRI modalities (structural, diffusion, functional). In practice, after standardizing data via the dcm2bids-skill, the agent dynamically routes datasets to the optimal neuroimage-pre-skill based on available modalities and cohort traits (e.g., dispatching T1w and fMRI data to fMRIPrep, or selecting specialized pipelines for infant cohorts). The qc-agent-skill then drives an evidence-based, semi-automated QC via a 3-D browser dashboard, utilizing a multi-tiered verification system to optimize failed cases and escalate complex issues for supervisor inspection. Quantitatively, our QC agent screened 558 production subjects, validating its automated flags against FreeSurfer's topology-defect metrics. The infant processing pipeline achieved a 100% (201/201) completion rate on QC-validated inputs. Importantly, NeuroPilot compresses the traditional 2--3 month timeline for training staff and processing complete datasets into a single week. NeuroPilot is deployed in https://wanda-cyberbench.com/.

</details>


### [3] [Performance of large language models in the optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07543)
*Joshua C. Vences,William T. Tran,Nikko Gimpaya,Catharine M. Walsh,Rishad J. Khan,Robert Bechara,Asher C. Wiggins,Celine N. Rousan,Kaitlyn V. G. L. Morgado,Angie Ibrahim,Kevin H. M. Kuo,Daniel von Renteln,Alexander Hann,Dennis L. Shung,Michael A. Scaffidi,Charles Ménard,Joshua Landy,Samir C. Grover*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究评估了五种多模态大语言模型（Claude Opus 4、Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-o3、GPT-4o、GPT-5）在结直肠息肉光学诊断中的准确性，基于PRIME数据集对132例病例进行分类。结果显示所有模型对肿瘤性vs非肿瘤性息肉的F1评分均>0.9，其中Gemini 2.5 Pro在浸润性vs非浸润性及低vs高级别腺瘤方面表现最佳，Claude Opus 4和GPT-5在Paris分类中正确率最高（41.7%），但灵敏度与特异性均未达到ESGE标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结直肠息肉的准确光学诊断对于指导切除策略和随访方案至关重要，而多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在基于图像的诊断方面展现出潜力。作者希望通过系统评估多种主流MLLM在息肉分类和病理预测中的表现，判断其是否达到临床应用标准。

Method: 采用回顾性诊断性能研究设计，使用PRIME数据集（含白光和窄带成像NBI图像），对Claude Opus 4、Google Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-o3、GPT-4o和GPT-5五种MLLM进行评估。针对Paris分类、NICE分类和预测病理分别计算F1分数、正确率和准确度，并与132例病例的专家判断进行对比；使用Cochran's Q和McNemar检验分析各模型预测值之间的显著性差异。

Result: 所有MLLM在肿瘤性vs非肿瘤性息肉区分上F1评分均>0.9。Gemini 2.5 Pro在浸润性vs非浸润性息肉（F1=0.560）和低vs高级别腺瘤（F1=0.492）上表现最佳。Claude Opus 4和GPT-5在Paris分类中正确率显著高于其他模型（41.7%）。但所有模型的灵敏度与特异性均未达到ESGE标准。

Conclusion: Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro在区分息肉亚型方面准确性最高，最接近专家共识水平。然而，当前MLLM的诊断性能尚未达到ESGE临床标准，需要通过前瞻性多中心试验和设计人机协同（human-in-the-loop）工作流程后再考虑临床部署。

Abstract: Background and Study Aims: Accurate optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps guides resection strategy and surveillance, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) showing potential for image-based diagnosis. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of MLLMs in classifying colorectal polyps and predicting histology. Methods: We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance study using the PRIME dataset, a curated set of white light and narrow-band imaging (NBI) images. We evaluated Claude Opus 4, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-o3, GPT-4o, and GPT-5. For Paris, Narrow-band Imaging Colorectal Endoscopic (NICE), and predicted histology, we calculated F1 scores, percent correct scores, and accuracy of each MLLM compared to expert responses for 132 cases. Cochran's Q and McNemar's Test were used to determine differences between predicted values of each MLLM. Results: The F1 scores among MLLMs were >0.9 for all models for neoplastic vs. non-neoplastic polyps. Gemini 2.5 Pro demonstrated the highest F1 scores for invasive vs. non-invasive polyps and low- vs. high-grade adenoma, at 0.560 and 0.492 respectively. Claude Opus 4 and GPT-5 had statistically significantly higher percent correct scores than other MLLMs at 41.7%, using Paris classification. Conclusions: Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro showed the highest accuracy in differentiating polyp subtypes, performing closest to expert consensus. Sensitivity and specificity, however, did not meet ESGE standards, highlighting the need for prospective multicenter trials and the design of human-in-the-loop workflows before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [4] [Ego-OSCAR: Egocentric Open source Stereo CAptuRe System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08285)
*Gunjan Paul,Senthil Palanisamy,Satpal Singh Rathore,Pratyush Kumar Patnaik,Shubhanshu Khatana,Abhishek Anand*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Ego-OSCAR是一个开源硬件、低成本（<200美元/台）的头戴式立体惯性采集设备，包含全球快门立体相机、6轴IMU、嵌入式Linux SBC和实时微控制器，并提供完整软件栈及约550小时带同步IMU的日常室内环境第一人称立体视频数据集，数据集配有开放词汇的动作标注和逐帧3D手部重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究级采集系统（如Project Aria）单台保真度高但成本高昂，难以支撑大规模众包式第一人称（egocentric）数据采集。作者旨在降低egocentric数据采集的准入门槛，让任何团队都能以极低成本和开放硬件进行规模化数据收集。

Method: 硬件上采用硬件同步的全局快门立体相机配合6轴IMU，嵌入式Linux SBC负责设备端视频编码，实时微控制器承担用户反馈和看门狗功能；全部使用商用组件和3D打印件，物料成本低于200美元。软件方面提供完整的采集流水线（硬件加速录制、IMU采样守护进程、时间同步工具和看门狗固件）。数据集包含约550小时/相机的立体视频及同步IMU数据，由分布式贡献者网络在室内环境采集，并提供开放词汇的自由文本动作标注、逐帧3D手部重建和逐会话立体标定。

Result: 成功构建了单台成本低于200美元的开源头戴式立体惯性采集设备，发布完整软硬件设计与约550小时的带标注第一人称数据集，验证了以低成本硬件支撑大规模众包egocentric数据采集的可行性。

Conclusion: Ego-OSCAR不追求每单位的采集保真度与Project Aria等研究级系统看齐，而是定位为最经济的可辩护的众包egocentric采集基底方案，旨在降低规模化数据采集的激活能量，全部硬件设计、软件和数据集均开源。

Abstract: We present Ego-OSCAR, an open-hardware, low-cost, head-mounted stereo-inertial capture device for egocentric data collection in the wild. EgoOSCAR pairs a hardware-synchronized global-shutter stereo camera with a 6- axis IMU, an embedded Linux SBC for on-device video encoding, and a realtime microcontroller for user feedback and watchdog functions. The complete bill of materials is under USD 200 per unit, using only commercially available components and 3D-printed parts. Alongside the device, we release a complete software stack (hardware-accelerated recording pipeline, IMU sampling daemon, time-synchronization tooling, and watchdog firmware) and roughly 550 hours of egocentric stereo video per camera with synchronized IMU, collected by a distributed contributor network across everyday indoor environments. The release is annotated rather than raw: free-form action captions cover essentially the entire recorded timeline with an open vocabulary, and per-frame 3D hand reconstructions ship alongside per-session stereo calibration. Ego-OSCAR does not aim to match the per-unit fidelity of research-grade systems such as Project Aria; it aims to be the cheapest defensible substrate for crowdsourced egocentric capture, and to lower the activation energy for any team that wants to collect egocentric data at scale. All hardware designs, software, and the dataset are open-sourced

</details>


### [5] [Learning an Interior Layout Policy in a Domain Specific Language Action Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07547)
*Yuhao Lu,Weichen Zhang,Wenyi Xiao,Haohui Chen,Yiyun Fei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LayoutDSL是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的室内场景布局生成框架，通过将布局推理过程建模为领域特定语言（DSL）动作空间中的策略学习，结合监督微调和强化学习，显著提升了布局的空间合理性与设计逻辑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有室内布局生成方法存在两大问题：(1) 任务被过度简化，将房间条件降为粗粒度3D边界框，忽略了门窗等结构元素；(2) 空间推理被建模为直接坐标预测（连续回归），阻碍模型学习智能布局设计背后的推理逻辑。

Method: 提出LayoutDSL框架：(1) 设计DSL提供布局信息的显式符号表示，作为一个结构化动作空间，每个动作对应一个可解释的设计决策；(2) 构建3D-FrontDSL数据集，包含房间结构注释与合成的DSL动作序列，用于监督微调；(3) 设计基于室内设计原则和物理合理性的奖励，通过强化学习优化策略，实现可验证反馈的更泛化、可扩展的策略。

Result: 大量实验表明，LayoutDSL在空间合理性和设计逻辑性方面显著优于强基线和现有方法。

Conclusion: 将室内布局生成从连续坐标回归范式转变为DSL动作空间中的可解释策略学习，能够更有效地捕获布局设计的底层推理逻辑，从而生成更合理、更有逻辑性的室内布局。

Abstract: Indoor scene layout generation is a challenging task in interior design. Existing methods often oversimplify the task by reducing room conditions to coarse 3D bounding boxes and neglecting structural elements such as doors and windows. More fundamentally, many prior approaches formulate spatial reasoning as direct coordinate prediction, thereby casting interior layout design as continuous regression over raw geometric parameters, which hinders the model from learning the underlying reasoning logic of intelligent layout design. We propose \textbf{LayoutDSL}, a novel LLM-based framework for learning an interior layout policy in a domain-specific language (DSL) action space. The DSL provides an explicit symbolic representation of layout information and serves as a structured action space for layout reasoning, where each action corresponds to an interpretable design decision. Under this DSL-based policy learning paradigm, we construct 3D-FrontDSL, a dataset of room-structure annotations paired with synthetic DSL action sequences for supervised fine-tuning. To promote a more generalizable and scalable policy with verifiable feedback, we design rewards grounded in interior design principles and physical plausibility, and optimize the policy via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayoutDSL substantially improves spatial plausibility and design logicality over strong baselines and existing methods.

</details>


### [6] [P2Voxel: Pyramid Pivot Voxelization for 3D Mesh Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07549)
*Zhenhong Sun,Haozhe Liu,Yifu Wang,Xibin Song,Senbo Wang,Huadong Mo,Daoyi Dong,Hongdong Li,Pan Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出P2Voxel，一个金字塔枢轴体素化框架，用于紧凑且重建感知的3D网格令牌化。它将网格令牌化重新定义为局部表面证据采样，通过局部平面性、空间复杂性和块可重建性三个关键假设，将网格转换为紧凑、结构化且可学习的金字塔枢轴令牌，实现高效的下游3D重建任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三角网格能提供显式且精确的表面几何，但其不规则的拓扑连接使得3D网格令牌化成为一个几何采样问题：如何将几何证据采样并组织成紧凑、结构化且可学习的令牌。现有的场中心体素采样和边交点表面采样方法未能充分利用网格的局部几何特性。

Method: P2Voxel基于三个关键创新：(1) 局部平面性假设下，枢轴体素化用表面枢轴和朝向符号表示每个活动体素，提供最小局部证据；(2) 空间复杂性假设下，金字塔枢轴体素化为几何复杂区域分配更细的枢轴令牌，而平滑区域保持粗粒度和紧凑性；(3) 块可重建性假设下，金字塔VAE在局部可重建枢轴块上学习紧凑的多分辨率潜码，避免建模整个高分辨率体素化形状为稠密全局场。

Result: P2Voxel将网格转换为紧凑、结构化且可学习的金字塔枢轴令牌，实现了高效的下游3D网格重建任务，验证了所提出框架在3D任务中的有效性。

Conclusion: P2Voxel通过将网格令牌化重定向为局部表面证据采样，并利用金字塔结构自适应分配令牌资源，解决了几何证据采样与组织的核心问题，为下游3D任务提供了高效可靠的网格表示。

Abstract: Triangle meshes provide explicit and accurate surface geometry, yet their irregular topology connectivity makes 3D mesh tokenization a geometric sampling problem: how to sample and organize geometric evidence into compact, structured and learnable tokens. Beyond field-centric volumetric sampling and edge-intersection surface sampling, we retarget mesh tokenization as \textit{local surface evidence sampling}: identifying the minimal geometric evidence inside each active voxel that is sufficient for deterministic surface recovery. To this end, we introduce \textbf{P2Voxel}, a pyramid pivot voxelization framework for compact and reconstruction-aware mesh tokenization. P2Voxel is built on three key innovations. Under the \textit{Local Planarity} assumption, Pivot Voxelization represents each active voxel with a surface pivot and an orientation sign, providing minimal local evidence that can induce the corner values required for deterministic reconstruction. Under the \textit{Spatial Complexity} assumption, Pyramid Pivot Voxelization exploits the spatial non-uniformity of real surfaces by allocating finer pivot tokens to geometrically complex regions while keeping smooth regions coarse and compact. Under the \textit{Block Reconstructability} assumption, a Pyramid VAE learns compact multi-resolution latent codes over locally reconstructable pivot blocks, avoiding the need to model the entire high-resolution voxelized shape as a dense global field. Together, these designs convert meshes into compact, structured, and learnable pyramid pivot tokens, enabling efficient mesh reconstruction for downstream 3D tasks.

</details>


### [7] [Auditing Medical Vision-Language Models on Chest Radiographs: Estimating Reference Agreement Across Institutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07550)
*Pengyang Yu,Yiou Wang,Zhongping Dong,Sahraoui Dhelim,Chun-Mei Feng,M. Tahar Kechadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文评估了三种生成式视觉语言模型在三个机构胸部X光影像语料库上的表现，发现接收机构无法从模型接口获得置信度，跨站点、发现类型、预测方向和问题格式的参考标准一致性大多未测量。在严格机构留出评估下，自适应估计器选择并未优于简单固定替代方案，且无法推荐默认估计器，表明参考一致性必须按站点和接口重新评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型返回结构化胸部X光发现时没有暴露置信度分数，接收机构无法判断个体判断的可信程度。跨站点、发现类别、预测方向和问题格式下与机构参考标准的一致性在很大程度上未被测量，这构成了临床部署中的关键不确定性。

Method: 在三个机构胸部X光语料库上评估三种生成式视觉语言模型，涵盖六种发现、两种引出协议，共超过345,000个发现级预测。利用少量本地标签预算估计接收机构的按发现-方向参考一致性，并基于重复的严格机构留出评估对应答器进行压力测试。七种估计器包括Beta-Binomial经验贝叶斯、目标仅逻辑模型以及跨机构池化等策略。

MVMD consists of three key blocks: the Inter-Views Block tracks the shifts of objects within mirrors caused by changes in viewpoint; the Intra-View Block detects object reflections inside mirrors; and the Refinement Block sharpens mirror boundaries and enhances detected details.

Explainable artificial intelligence techniques, including LIME, LRP, Attention-Min, and Attention-Max, were used to improve model transparency and clinical trust. The attention map also highlighted the effects of CKD progression in these regions. Compared with existing methods, the proposed method classified the five CKD stages and normal kidney status with a 4% improvement in accuracy.

FloodLlama-MI5 and FloodLlama-MI6 leverage this insight by fine-tuning only five or six of the eight cross-attention layers, achieving an 86-88% reduction in trainable parameters (6.55-7.86 million versus 54.4 million) with minimal accuracy loss. On a real-world benchmark, FloodLlama-MI6 achieves 98.62% accuracy, compared with 86.61% for the published STURM-FloodDepth baseline.

Abstract: Conversational assistants increasingly recommend follow-up edits to help users continue a task. We collected 100,000 real multi-turn image-creation conversation samples from Qwen App and found that 80.1% are image-dependent, underscoring the need for multimodal recommendation. In Stage 1, we use real online data to build a human-reviewed table of appropriate follow-up editing intents, then create SFT targets and fine-tune a multimodal policy. In Stage 2, to align rule-guided SFT suggestions with actual user choices, we use user click feedback to optimize the policy through multi-objective reinforcement learning. In Stage 3, to reduce visual inconsistencies between suggested edits and the current image, we introduce a visual verifier as additional training supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms baselines on both automatic and human evaluations. In a live user-randomized A/B test with millions of users, our final framework reduces visual inconsistency from 3.7% to 0.9%. Furthermore, it significantly improves recommendation CTR by 32.70%, image take-away rate by 16.32%, and average conversation turns per user by 39.90% (all p<0.05).

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) classification, yet existing approaches assume temporally aligned evaluation. In practice, the optimal observation window varies across subjects due to differences in hemodynamic delay and neurovascular coupling, creating a temporal distribution shift that degrades performance. We formalize this as a \textit{cross-time-window transfer problem}, introducing a protocol that varies window length (2.5--10\,s) and offset within biological motion trials. Using topographic map representations of fNIRS recordings, we benchmark three vision architectures under two zero-shot baselines and eight adaptation strategies under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation ($N{=}124$). Key findings: (1) zero-shot cross-window accuracy is near chance (54--69\%); (2) ${\approx}5\%$ subject-specific fine-tuning recovers 90--96\%, while a subject-specific upper bound reaches 97--100\%, identifying inter-subject variability as the dominant barrier; (3) domain-adversarial and self-supervised strategies achieve 78--90\% without target-subject data; and (4) discriminative information is recoverable from windows as short as 2.5\,s. Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in high-fidelity image and video generation. Segmentation accuracy matches inter-expert agreement. Continuity-aware training improves reconstruction smoothness and suppresses a periodic terracing artifact at minimal accuracy cost.   <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 论文的贡献是一个开放世界感知层，对词汇表外的物体绝不做出置信的类别错误，同时对其代价给出诚实的说明。这是安全性结果而非特异性结果——优先保证永远不自信地犯错，而非准确恢复正确类别。

Abstract: A closed-set detector for autonomous driving must assign every object one of a fixed set of labels. On an object outside that set (a horse-drawn carriage, road debris, livestock on a rural road) it can only force a confident but wrong specific label or drop the object. Prior work in this series replaced the flat label set with a hierarchical taxonomy and a runtime abstraction rule, but evaluated it only on the boxes a closed detector already produces. This paper takes the layer open-world: we place taxonomic abstraction on top of class-agnostic region proposals so objects the closed detector never boxes can still be classified or flagged; we report a feasibility study of three open-world signals (class-agnostic segmentation, appearance-based out-of-distribution scoring, monocular depth) that shows why no single 2D cue suffices and how they compose; and we run the evaluation the earlier papers could not, a ground-truth leave-classes-out benchmark on real annotated objects. Holding out seven COCO classes and classifying their 235 ground-truth crops, a flat closed head emits a confident wrong specific label 100% of the time (37% of them in the wrong super-category, e.g. an animal named as a vehicle), whereas the hierarchical layer emits zero confident wrong specific labels and safely handles 94% of the objects (a correct super-category, or an explicit UNKNOWN OBSTACLE). We are explicit that this is a safety result, not a specificity one: the correct super-category is recovered only 26% of the time and the remaining 69% are conservatively flagged unknown. The contribution is an open-world perception layer that never makes a confident categorical mistake on an out-of-vocabulary object, together with an honest account of its cost.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 提出MBPO框架：1) 在视觉-语言决策边界构建推理树，允许兄弟分支探索多样的视觉假设；2) 通过分支相对优势（branch-relative advantages）进行段级信用分配（segment-level credit）；3) 引入时间回放缓冲区（temporal replay buffer）复用信息段并控制策略过期程度。

Abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning methods for multimodal large language models typically rely on trajectory-level credit assignment that applies a single advantage to all tokens in a response. However, multimodal reasoning involves substantially higher perceptual uncertainty than text-only settings, where the model must repeatedly re-examine visual information to verify intermediate interpretations, and different visual groundings can lead to divergent reasoning paths, making such uniform credit assignment particularly inadequate and causing relative advantages to progressively degenerate toward zero. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Branch Policy Optimization (MBPO), a tree-based framework that constructs reasoning trees at vision-language decision boundaries, enabling sibling branches to explore diverse visual hypotheses and assigning segment-level credit through branch-relative advantages. Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have made rapid progress in visual perception and increasingly support real-world tasks that depend on images. We introduce COMPLEXITYWORLD, a benchmark of 390 tasks across 39 domain-inspired visual worlds and 29 decision categories. Each task is generated from a hidden structured specification, rendered as a visual scene, and scored by an exe- cutable verifier that accepts any feasible solution. Under direct inference, all evaluated models ex- cept GPT-5.6-Sol remain below 40% verifier ac- ceptance rate (VAR), while GPT-5.6-Sol reaches 75.6%. Performance improves substantially when the same decision information is made explicit in structured form, yet varies sharply across equiva- lent visual presentations. Agent scaffolds provide smaller, model-dependent gains. Together, these results reveal a persistent visual-to-decision bot- tleneck that additional inference alone does not remove.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和CG-Bench上的大量实验表明，LAVE在多个骨干网络上一致提升视频工具使用代理的性能。在可比的帧预算下，LAVE在Video-MME整体得分上比最强基线高出3.76分。

Abstract: Long-video understanding requires models to efficiently acquire and reuse sparse visual evidence from long and redundant video streams. Recent video tool-use agents address this challenge by iteratively invoking visual Tools at different temporal scales, but their Tool-Planner communication typically relies on textual observations. Such text-only interfaces provide lossy summaries of Tool computations, causing previously computed visual evidence not verbalized to be discarded and unavailable for subsequent planning. We identify this limitation as the Tool observation bottleneck and propose Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning (LAVE), a training-free framework for reusing latent visual evidence from completed Tool calls. LAVE introduces a dual-channel observation interface: the visible channel preserves the original textual trajectory, while the latent channel stores pre-verbal visual updates with their Tool roles, source-frame timestamps, and visual locations. During planning, LAVE retrieves evidence relevant to the current Planner state but not covered by textual observations, and integrates it through bounded timestamp-aligned latent updates with entropy-constrained frame-time routing. This enables video agents to reuse existing visual computation without additional training, frame replay, or modifications to the original orchestration. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and CG-Bench show that LAVE consistently improves video tool-use agents across backbones. </details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在CIFAR-100、CUB-200和ImageNet-R数据集上，分别以1%、5%和10%的标签比例进行实验，MAGIC在平均增量精度上优于大多数配备FixMatch的监督CIL方法和原生SSCIL基线。最大的性能提升出现在细粒度、低标签比例的场景中，这正是置信度阈值化方法失效最明显的场景。

Conclusion: MAGIC通过几何约束将适配器限制在稳定的特征空间中，使得类间几何关系在新类不断加入时保持稳定，从而在无需存储任何旧样本的条件下有效缓解灾难性遗忘，特别在细粒度和低标签率场景下优势显著。

Abstract: Semi-supervised Class Incremental Learning (SSCIL) is a severe challenge for neural networks, and it is hardest in the exemplar-free setting where no past data may be stored. Existing methods forget catastrophically due to feature drift, and their pseudo-labels become increasingly unreliable as the label space grows. In this paper, we propose MAGIC (Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration), a framework that stabilizes plasticity without storing exemplars. MAGIC's design centers on two components. The first is Soft-Weighted Geometry Calibration (SWGC), which uses graph-based label propagation on the learner's plastic feature space to weight and calibrate class means and variances computed on the frozen backbone; from these calibrated Gaussians, we sample phantom features that stand in for data from previous tasks. The second is a Geometric Structural Alignment (GSA) objective that preserves representation topology by matching the relational structure of student and teacher heads and aligning feature anchors with the fixed classifier prototypes, locking the orientation of the feature space. Together, these constraints keep the adapter from drifting, so geometric relations between classes remain stable as new classes arrive. We implement MAGIC with a frozen ResNet-18 backbone and a learnable plastic adapter. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and ImageNet-R, at label ratios of 1%, 5%, and 10%, MAGIC improves average incremental accuracy over most of the supervised CIL methods equipped with FixMatch and native SSCIL baselines; the largest gains occur in the fine-grained, low-label setting, where confidence thresholding fails most clearly.

</details>

Abstract: Land Surface Temperature (LST) is a widely used satellite-derived measure of urban surface heat, but there is no shared benchmark for forecasting it at 30 m. We evaluate a CNN+LSTM and Earthformer on next-month forecasting, where Earthformer reaches 7.74 K RMSE against 10.42 K for the CNN+LSTM. Forecasting from the eight nonLST channels alone reaches 7.72 K, against 8.15 K from LST history and 8.68 K from RGB. </details>

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了一种纯几何、与类别无关的交通计数流水线，在树莓派级单片机上通过背景减除和几何规则（虚拟感应线圈）替代深度学习目标检测器，无需训练集和轨迹，在实时性能下达到83%-100%的计数准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前交通数据采集主导范式是深度目标检测器加跟踪（tracking-by-detection），但该范式假设检测器已针对目标类别完成训练，这在实践中往往不成立（例如没有标注数据的开放类别场景）。作者希望探索一种不依赖目标模型和训练数据的纯几何替代方案。

Method: 采用类无关的运动目标检测：背景减除加阈值分割获得运动物体；然后通过跨道路虚拟线的几何规则进行计数（软件感应线圈）。提出两种计数规则：常数平均速度规则（解析推导出约86%的期望精度）和自校准预标定规则（从斑块统计恢复车道几何并基于车道路占计数，同时免费获得每车平均速度）。比较Python（易调参、100% CPU）和C++（40% CPU、热可行）实现。

Conclusion: 基于运动、类无关的检测在以下场景仍是正确工具：无标注数据的开放类别、紧张的功耗预算、隐私受限安装，以及引导学习检测器的训练裁剪冷启动。这些观察属于采样几何属性而非当时硬件的限制，至今仍约束边缘部署。

Abstract: Traffic data collection is dominated today by deep object detectors followed by tracking-by-detection, a pipeline that presupposes what is often missing in practice: a detector already trained on the class one wants to count. We revisit a purely geometric traffic-sensing pipeline for Single Board Computers in which detection is class-agnostic: moving objects come from background subtraction and thresholding, and counting is decided by a geometric rule on an imaginary line across the road, a software inductive loop detector. With no object model, training set or per-object trajectory, it runs faster than real time on Raspberry Pi class hardware. Two counting rules are described: a constant average speed rule, whose expected accuracy is derived analytically as about 86% under a Gaussian speed distribution, and a self-calibrating pre-calibration rule that recovers the lane geometry from blob statistics and counts edges of lane occupancy, additionally yielding per-vehicle average speed at no extra cost. Over four videos the latter counts with 83.3%-100% accuracy; in a field deployment it reaches 91% against 37.5% for a blob-tracking baseline under the same compute budget. We report the observations of that period in detail: the resolution floor below which accuracy collapses, the frame rate floor at which vehicles alias past the counting line, the gap between short curated clips and long uncontrolled footage, and the trade-off between Python (easier to tune, 100% CPU) and C++ (40% CPU, thermally viable). These are properties of the sampling geometry, not of the hardware of the time, and still constrain edge deployments. We close by arguing where motion-based, class-agnostic detection remains the right tool: open-set classes with no annotated data, tight power budgets, privacy-constrained installations, and the cold start of mining training crops to bootstrap a learned detector.

</details>

*Yeeun Choi,Youngbeom Yoo,Joon-Young Lee,Hyolim Kang,Seon Joo Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MERIT提出一种针对超长视频（小时到天级）理解的双阶段框架，通过多键片段检索表示与推理时邻近过滤的时序扩展，在EgoLifeQA、LVBench和Video-MME（Long）三个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超长视频（数小时至数天）无法被当前MLLM端到端处理，现有工作在不了解下游查询的情况下花费大量算力构建复杂的高层关系记忆，效率低且缺乏针对性。作者主张在记忆构建阶段优先保证高召回可检索性，将查询相关的高层关系组合推迟到推理阶段。

Method: 提出MERIT框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) 情景式多键表示（Multi-key Episodic Representation），通过简单的键匹配机制实现细粒度记忆的精确检索；(2) 邻居过滤机制（Neighbor Filtering），在推理阶段仅围绕检索到的片段进行时序范围扩展，捕获更广泛的语义上下文，避免了全局记忆构建的庞大计算开销。

Result: 在EgoLifeQA、LVBench和Video-MME（Long）三个长视频基准上取得最优性能（SOTA），验证了简单键匹配配合按需时序扩展的有效性。

Conclusion: 记忆构建阶段应优先优化可检索性而非预建模高层关系；将查询相关的关系组合延迟至推理阶段，配合按需的局部时序扩展，可以在避免全局计算开销的同时获得更好的超长视频理解性能。

Abstract: When videos extend from hours to days, directly processing them end-to-end becomes impractical for current Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). This ultra-long setting necessitates a two-stage paradigm: query-agnostic memory construction followed by retrieval-based inference. Prior work invests in complex memory construction to pre-model high-level relations in videos, despite not knowing the downstream query at build time. We instead prioritize high-recall retrievability during memory building, and defer query-specific, high-level relation composition to inference time. To this end, we propose MERIT(Multi-key Episodic Retrieval with Inference-time Temporal expansion), a simple yet effective agentic framework for ultra-long video understanding. First, we formulate an episodic multi-key representation that enables precise retrieval of fine-grained memories through a simple key-matching mechanism. Second, we introduce a neighbor filtering mechanism to capture broader semantic context without the massive computational overhead of global memory construction. This is achieved by expanding the temporal scope exclusively around the retrieved segments at inference time. By leveraging simple key-matching with this on-demand temporal expansion, MERIT achieves state-of-the-art performance across three long-video benchmarks: EgoLifeQA, LVBench, and Video-MME (Long).

</details>

Abstract: Generative traffic video forecasting aims to synthesize long-horizon, temporally coherent future videos of traffic scenes from a short observation history and textual descriptions. In this paper, we present CosmosAlign, a generative traffic video forecasting framework built upon the pretrained Cosmos3-Nano world foundation model. Our approach is motivated by the observation that successfully adapting large pretrained world models to downstream forecasting tasks depends primarily on distribution alignment rather than increased model capacity. To this end, we propose a two-stage LoRA adaptation strategy that first aligns the conditioning-mode distribution with the target forecasting task, and then aligns the training captions with the model's native structured prompting interface through an LLM-based re-captioning pipeline. During inference, we further improve prediction quality using a fully training-free procedure consisting of consensus-based medoid sample selection and motion-adaptive blending of static scene regions. CosmosAlign achieves a final score of 76.49 on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 benchmark, ranking first on the final leaderboard. Our code is publicly available at https://quangminhdinh.github.io/CosmosAlign/.

</details>

Abstract: Estimating volumetric mechanical properties, including Young's modulus, Poisson's ratio, and density at each voxel, is intrinsically ambiguous from vision alone, as visually similar objects may have substantially different material compositions and physical behavior. Abstract: Cross-View Geo-Localization (CVGL) with OpenStreetMap (OSM) performs well in structure-rich urban environments but collapses in feature-sparse scenes such as rural roads. Motivation: 移动端VQA系统越来越多地将推理卸载到云端VLM，但商业API对模型内部和推理行为暴露极少控制，客户端预处理成为下游开发者最主要的优化空间。然而，这些预处理技术对商业云VLM的成本-质量影响从未被系统研究过，缺乏基准来指导工程实践。

Result: 预处理并非普遍有效：其效果高度依赖目标模型、API范式、提供商token计费规则及任务形式。不恰当的预处理策略可能同时增加部署成本和延迟，并降低答案准确率。总体而言，VQABench厘清了预处理何时有效、何时失效及其原因。

Conclusion: VQABench填补了客户端预处理对云VLM-VQA系统影响的研究空白，提供了何时、为何预处理有效或失效的清晰洞察，为未来研究和实际部署的VQA系统提供了指导依据。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are becoming a practical backend for mobile visual question answering (VQA) systems, enabling smartphones and smart glasses to answer users' questions about the physical world. Since modern VLMs remain difficult to run on mobile and edge devices, VQA systems increasingly offload inference to cloud-based VLMs. This gives mobile devices access to stronger computation, but it also makes visual input preparation a key system variable: how the image is prepared before offloading affects not only answer quality but also payload size, token cost, and system latency. Proprietary APIs expose little control over model internals or serving behavior, leaving client-side preprocessing as the main practical optimization space for downstream developers. Many such techniques have been proposed for visual offloading, yet their cost-quality impact on commercial cloud VLMs has never been studied. To fill this gap, we present VQABench, the first systematic benchmark that treats client-side input preprocessing as a controlled variable for cloud-VLM-based VQA. We evaluate 12 preprocessing techniques across three VQA datasets and four commercial VLMs from three providers, totaling 95,168 API calls. Our results show that preprocessing is not universally beneficial: its effectiveness depends on the target model, API paradigm, provider token-accounting rule, and task formulation. A poorly selected preprocessing strategy can increase deployment cost or latency while degrading answer accuracy. Overall, our benchmark clarifies when preprocessing helps, when it fails, and why, providing insights to guide future research and real-world deployment of VQA systems.

</details>

*Qian Yao,Jun-Jie Huang,Yongjun Wang,Luming Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LHSDet是一种新型高分辨率AI生成图像检测器，将检测任务建模为视觉问答问题，采用三分支架构（低层视觉分支、高层视觉分支和语义文本分支）融合多模态特征，有效解决现有方法因下采样而忽略高分辨率图像细节纹理以及面对未知生成模型泛化能力不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测方法通常对图像进行下采样处理，不可避免地丢失高分辨率图像中关键的低层纹理细节，限制了检测性能；同时，不断涌现的未知生成模型使得大规模预训练数据集难以获取。

Method: LHSDet将AI生成图像检测任务建模为视觉问答（VQA）问题，采用三分支架构：1) 低层视觉分支通过聚合非重叠图像块提取局部纹理线索；2) 高层视觉分支基于SigLIP2进行全局感知特征提取；3) 语义级文本分支利用BLIP-2生成图像描述。整个框架基于微调的视觉-语言模型，重新设计视觉编码器以更好地捕获AI生成图像中的低层和高层伪影，并通过多模态特征融合实现检测。

Result: 大量实验表明，LHSDet在多种生成模型（包括扩散模型和自回归模型）上均取得了高检测精度和稳健的性能，展现出良好的跨模型泛化能力。

Conclusion: LHSDet通过将检测任务转化为VQA问题并采用三分支多模态融合架构，有效解决了高分辨率AI生成图像检测中纹理细节丢失和未知生成模型泛化两大挑战，为视觉-语言模型在AI内容检测领域的应用提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Driven by advances in diffusion models and autoregressive models, the fidelity and resolution of AI-generated images now rival those of real images. However, existing AI-generated image detection methods often downsample the images, inevitably overlooking critical low-level texture details in high-resolution AI-generated images, therefore limiting their detection performance. In addition, the ceaseless emergence of unknown generative models makes large-scale pre-training datasets inaccessible. To address these challenges, we propose a novel high-resolution AI-generated image detector, termed LHSDet. Specifically, we formulate the AI-generated image detection task as a Visual Question Answering problem, leveraging a fine-tuned vision-language framework to fully exploit the complementary information between visual and textual modalities. Recognizing that the default visual encoder of existing vision-language models is not tailored for AI-generated image detection, we redesign a visual encoder to better capture both the low-level and high-level artifacts inherent in AI-generated images. Furthermore, we incorporate a semantic-level textual branch to enable multi-modal feature fusion and detection. Consequently, LHSDet employs a triple-branch architecture to extract complementary multi-modal features: a low-level visual branch that aggregates non-overlapping patches for local texture cues, a high-level visual branch based on SigLIP2 for global perception feature extraction, and a semantic-level textual branch that generates captions using BLIP-2. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that LHSDet achieves high detection accuracy and robust performance across diverse generative models, including both diffusion and autoregressive models.

</details>


### [50] [UniScale: Arbitrary-Scale Industrial Anomaly Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07864)
*Shilei Zeng,Linxin Guan,Xurui Li,Yaohan Tang,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniScale是一个统一的训练和推理框架，用于任意尺度下的高保真工业异常生成。它通过误差抑制的多尺度训练策略和先生成后融合的去噪推理方法，解决了扩散模型中极端下采样导致小尺度异常信息丢失的问题，在异常生成质量和下游检测性能上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业异常检测面临真实异常样本匮乏的问题，虽然生成模型可用于创建异常数据，但现有方法在处理小尺度异常时表现不佳。根本原因是扩散模型中的极端下采样导致小异常信息在潜空间中被丢失。

Method: 提出UniScale框架，包含两部分：(1) 训练阶段采用误差抑制多尺度训练（EMT）策略，使模型学习丰富的位置感知异常纹理，同时抑制上采样引入的插值误差；(2) 推理阶段提出先生成后融合去噪（Generation-then-Fusion Denoising），将异常生成与背景集成解耦，防止小异常被淹没。

Result: 在VisA上IS(a)相对提升45.86%（从1.81到2.64），在MVTec AD 2上提升37.70%（从1.22到1.68）；下游像素级IoU在VisA上提升4.22%，AUROC在MVTec AD 2上提升6.55%。代码已开源。

Conclusion: UniScale通过多尺度训练策略与生成-融合解耦推理框架，同时兼顾小尺度异常的学习能力与常规尺度异常的有效性，在异常生成质量和下游检测性能上均达到先进的水平。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly inspection faces a major challenge due to the lack of real-world anomaly samples. While generative models are used to create anomaly data, existing methods still struggle when handling small-scale anomalies.This failure occurs because extreme downsampling in diffusion models causes the information of small anomalies to be lost in the latent space.To address this, we introduce UniScale, a unified training and inference framework for high-fidelity industrial anomaly generation across arbitrary scales.During training, we introduce an Error-Suppressed Multi-Scale Training (EMT) strategy, which enables the model to learn the rich location-aware textures of anomalies, while suppressing upsampling-induced interpolation errors in texture acquisition, ensuring the model is capable of learning small-scale anomalies, while remaining effective for regular scale anomalies.For inference, we propose Generation-then-Fusion Denoising. It decouples anomaly generation from background integration, preventing small anomalies from being overwhelmed.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art competitors in both anomaly generation quality and downstream detection performance.It achieves a relative IS(a) improvement of 45.86\% (from 1.81 to 2.64) on VisA and 37.70\% (from 1.22 to 1.68) on MVTec AD 2, while also improving the downstream pixel-level IoU by 4.22\% on VisA and AUROC by 6.55\% on MVTec AD 2. </details>


### [51] [Vision-Language Grounding as Bidirectional Concept Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07886)
*Jieyu Zhang,Ziqi Gao,Luke Zettlemoyer,Ranjay Krishna*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将视觉-语言接地（grounding）重新定义为"双向概念对应"（bidirectional concept correspondence）问题，即同时完成文本分割、图像分割和跨模态对齐，无需预设相关文本短语。作者提出ConCor-1模型，基于预训练的视觉-语言模型，使用可学习的桥接token（bridge tokens）来预测文本掩码、图像掩码及对应存在分数，在统一格式的数据集上训练和评估，相比基线在长文本描述数据集上对应F1提升48%，在零样本LVIS上提升29%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言接地任务大多被简化为单向定位问题：给定预设的文本短语或类别名，找到对应的图像区域。这种设定假设相关语言单元已知，忽略了接地沟通中更基本的挑战——确定文本的哪些部分是视觉可指的（visually referential），以及它们如何与图像中的实体对应。作者旨在解决这一更基础的问题。

Method: 作者将接地形式化为双向概念对应问题：给定图像-文本对，恢复所有视觉可指文本片段与实例级图像分割之间的对应关系。该方法统一了短语接地、指称表达接地和开放词汇检测等常见任务。为此提出ConCor-1模型，构建在预训练视觉-语言模型之上，使用可学习的桥接token表示候选的图像-文本对应关系，每个token预测文本掩码、图像掩码和对应存在分数。同时将多种接地和分割数据集转换为统一的对应格式用于训练和评估。

Result: 实验表明ConCor-1在各项基线对比中一致胜出，在长文本描述数据集上对应F1提升48%，在零样本LVIS（大型类别列表作为文本输入）上提升29%。

Conclusion: 通过将接地重新定义为双向概念对应问题，并引入ConCor-1模型，本文表明可以不依赖预设文本短语来同时进行文本分割、图像分割和跨模态对齐，从而更全面地解决视觉-语言接地问题，并在多个任务和数据集上取得显著性能提升。

Abstract: Vision-language grounding connects language to visual content, yet most existing formulations reduce grounding to a unidirectional localization problem: given a prespecified text phrase or category name, identify the corresponding image region. This setup assumes that the relevant linguistic unit is already known, overlooking a more basic challenge in grounded communication: determining which parts of the text are visually referential and how they correspond to entities in the image. We formulate grounding as $\textit{bidirectional concept correspondence}$ over an image-text pair. Given an image and its paired text, the goal is to recover all correspondences between visually referential text spans and instance-level image segments, without assuming that the relevant text spans are provided. This formulation unifies common grounding tasks, including phrase grounding, referring expression grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, by treating text segmentation, image segmentation, and cross-modal alignment as a single correspondence prediction problem. To address this task, we introduce $\textbf{ConCor-1}$, a grounding model built on top of a pretrained vision-language model. To train and evaluate this task, we convert diverse grounding and segmentation datasets into a unified correspondence format. Experiments show that $\textbf{ConCor-1}$ consistently outperforms baselines, improving correspondence F1 by 48% on the long-caption dataset and by 29% on zero-shot LVIS, where the large category list serves as the text input.

</details>


### [52] [DeCo: Zero-Shot Industrial Anomaly Generation through Decoupling and Recoupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07904)
*Shilei Zeng,Xurui Li,Yaohan Tang,Yu Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DeCo是一种零样本工业异常生成方法，通过解耦异常结构与源产品、再与目标产品正常纹理重耦合的方式，利用双路由流（DR-Flow）获取纹理不变异常结构并绑定到异常令牌，同时用产品不变流（PI-Flow）防止异常令牌与源产品耦合；融合阶段采用混合注入和产品兼容性校正（PCC）实现异常结构—产品的显式重耦合。在MVTec AD和VisA数据集上分别实现5.1%和8.2%的像素AP提升，达到新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业异常检测受限于真实异常数据稀缺。现有零样本异常生成方法存在两个关键缺陷：异常信息获取不准确（异常结构错误地携带源产品特征）以及异常-产品融合不受控（生成结果与目标产品纹理不协调）。

Method: DeCo将异常生成分解为解耦与重耦合两个阶段。信息获取阶段：DR-Flow将纹理不变的异常结构绑定到异常令牌，同时PI-Flow作为并行约束阻止异常令牌绑定源产品信息；融合阶段：采用混合注入（hybrid injection）将获取的异常结构重耦合到目标产品上，并通过产品兼容性校正（PCC）补偿异常结构与目标产品之间的不兼容性。

Result: 在MVTec AD上像素AP提升5.1%，在VisA上提升8.2%，下游检测模型训练效果显著，达到新的最先进水平。

Conclusion: DeCo通过显式解耦-重耦合范式有效解决零样本工业异常生成中的信息获取不准确和融合不受控两大问题，证明了该方法的有效性与泛化性，并可推动零样本异常生成的后续研究。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly inspection is severely hindered by the scarcity of real anomalous data.Zero-shot industrial anomaly generation addresses this by generating anomalies on specific products without requiring any of their real anomalous images. However, existing methods suffer from two critical limitations, i.e., inaccurate anomaly information acquisition and uncontrolled anomaly-product fusion.To overcome these challenges, we propose DeCo, which decouples the anomaly structure from its source product, and explicitly recouples it with the normal textures of the target product. During anomaly information acquisition,Dual-Routing Flow (DR-Flow) binds the texture-invariant anomaly structure to an abnormal token, while a parallel constraint, Product-Invariant Flow (PI-Flow), prevents the abnormal token from binding the source product. </details>


### [53] [SegDem: Segmentation helps Demosaicing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07916)
*Ping Chen,Xiangming Wang,Yongyong Chen,Jiezhang Cao,Kai Zhang,Jingyong Su,Jie Liu,Haijin Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SegDem，一种基于跨任务解码器表示转移的联合去马赛克框架，利用实例分割的结构信息（区域和边界感知表示）来提升RAW图像的彩色重建质量，并在多种骨干网络和Bayer/Quad-Bayer CFA布局上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去马赛克方法将问题视为纯像素级重建，主要依赖局部纹理、跨通道相关性和低级图像统计，忽略了重建与高层视觉理解（如实例分割）共享同一物理世界的结构信息。作者洞察到重建和理解是同一场景结构的互补视角，二者推断出的结构信息应保持一致，因此引入实例分割来辅助去马赛克。

Conclusion: 去马赛克与高层视觉理解可以互为补充，跨任务结构信息共享是提升低级图像重建质量的有效途径，为未来联合低层重建与高层理解任务提供了新思路。

Abstract: Image demosaicing reconstructs a full-color image from incomplete color measurements produced by a sensor covered with a color filter array (CFA). Most existing methods formulate demosaicing as pixel-level reconstruction and mainly rely on local textures, cross-channel correlations, and low-level image statistics. Our core insight is that reconstruction and visual understanding can be viewed as complementary views of shared scene structure: both are grounded in the same underlying physical world, and therefore the structural and physical information inferred from an image should remain consistent across the two tasks. We instantiate this idea with instance segmentation and propose \emph{SegDem}, a cross-task decoder representation transfer framework for demosaicing. SegDem first learns region- and boundary-aware representations through instance-aware structural pretraining and then transfers the decoder to RAW-conditioned reconstruction. Segmentation- and demosaicing-conditioned features are further anchored to a shared frozen DINOv2 representation space to preserve structural organization across tasks. </details>


### [54] [Forged Peer Judgments Mislead Multimodal LLM Judge Panels: Source-Blind Anchoring and Panel-Consensus Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07920)
*Yang Shu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示多模态LLM评审小组中"源盲锚定"（source-blind anchoring）是一种文本级攻击面：引用的同行视觉判断（即使是伪造的）会使VLM评审结果产生19-26个百分点的锚定偏差。作者提出了"小组共识验证"（panel-consensus verification）防御方法，可阻断84.9%的伪造攻击并将净伤害降低97.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态LLM评审小组通过交叉引用同行判断来提高评估质量，但被引用的同行判断本身可能不可信。现有的工作未充分探索"引用他人判断"这一环节作为攻击面的风险，尤其是引用来源对评审结果的影响是否存在系统性偏差。

Method: 作者设计了自我（self）与同伴（peer）两种引用框架，对比相同内容的标签仅控制组来隔离标签自身的影响；在两种数据集和七种VLM评审器上测试精心构造的简短错误引用对正确判决的颠覆率；并提出panel-consensus verification方法，通过独立收集的盲投票交叉验证引用内容。

Result: 锚定效应在自我和同伴框架下均产生19-26个百分点差距；标签控制组仅改变-0.17pp（95%CI排除显著差异），证明效应并非标签本身所致。精心生成的错误引用使正确判决被颠覆的概率是自然错误同行语句的1.5-2.7倍（bootstrap 95%CI排除奇偶性）。防御方法阻断84.9%伪造攻击，净伤害降低97.5%，且保留对真实同行信息的正面（但统计上不显著）估计。

Conclusion: 引用的同行判断构成了低成本、高影响的攻击面，但通过小组共识验证可以有效地防御此类攻击，为更安全的多模态协同评估提供了具体方案。

Abstract: Multimodal LLM judge panels can cross-reference peers, but a quoted peer judgment may itself be untrusted. We expose source-blind anchoring as a text-level attack surface in vision-language model (VLM) panels. Quoting independent visual judgments creates large anchoring gaps (19--26 percentage points) under both self and peer framing. A matched-content, label-only control changes the broken rate by only $-0.17$pp (95\% CI $[-0.68,0.35]$), showing that the self/peer label itself does not explain the effect. Under our tested construction, deliberately generated, concise wrong quotes overturn originally-correct verdicts 1.5--2.7$\times$ more often than naturally occurring wrong peer statements, with bootstrap 95\% CIs excluding parity across two datasets and seven VLM judges. Because the two statement populations differ in selection and form, this ratio measures differential damage under the tested attack rather than a provenance-only causal effect. We then introduce panel-consensus verification, which cross-checks a quote against independently collected blind votes. It blocks 84.9\% of fabricated attacks, cuts their net harm by 97.5\%, and preserves the positive but statistically inconclusive point estimate for genuine peer information under leave-one-out re-verification. These results identify a low-cost attack surface and a concrete defense for safer multimodal collaborative evaluation.

</details>


### [55] [SCoPE: Training-Free Audio-Visual Event Perception via Sparse Cross-Modal Prior Exchange](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07923)
*Jaemo Jeong,Junho Yoon,Hyunju Kim,Dongman Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SCoPE，一个无需训练的音视频事件感知（AVEP）框架，通过让所有查询标签竞争共享证据、每个模态引导另一个模态的事件选择，从而解决错误标签与正确标签共同激活（FCA）的问题。在相同冻结CLIP+CLAP骨干下，相比AV^2A在LLP上Type@seg提升7.45点、Event@seg提升5.04点，且固定配置可无缝迁移到OV-AVEBench和VGGSound-AVEL100k。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的无需训练的音视频事件感知方法通过匹配冻结的音视频特征与文本编码的事件名称来查询事件词汇。然而相关标签共享证据，导致错误标签的得分可能不低于正确标签，即"假共同激活"（FCA）问题。标量截断无法在拒绝错误标签的同时保留所有正确标签，而类别特定阈值只能阻止错误标签成为最终预测，无法消除底层得分向量中的FCA。

Method: SCoPE是一个无需训练的框架，核心机制为：（1）所有查询标签竞争共享的证据；（2）每种模态引导另一种模态的事件选择。作者推导了两标签拟合下该竞争机制消除FCA的精确条件。

Result: 在相同冻结CLIP+CLAP骨干的设置下，相比已报告的AV^2A数值，SCoPE在LLP数据集上Type@seg提升7.45个百分点，Event@seg提升5.04个百分点。同一固定配置无需改动即可迁移到OV-AVEBench和VGGSound-AVEL100k。

Conclusion: SCoPE通过标签间竞争与跨模态引导机制有效解决了FCA问题，显著提升了无需训练的音视频事件感知性能，并且具有良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract: Audio-visual event perception (AVEP) determines which events occur in a video, when they occur, and whether they are audible, visible, or both. Training-free methods query new event vocabularies by matching frozen audio and visual features with text-encoded event names. However, related labels share evidence. An incorrect label can then score at least as high as a correct one. We call this a false co-activation (FCA). No scalar cutoff can reject the incorrect label while keeping every correct one. Class-specific thresholds may prevent that label from becoming a final prediction, but the FCA remains in the underlying score vector. We introduce SCoPE, a training-free framework in which all queried labels compete for shared evidence and each modality guides event selection in the other. We derive an exact condition for when this competition removes an FCA in a two-label fit. With identical frozen CLIP+CLAP backbones on LLP, SCoPE improves Type@seg by 7.45 points and Event@seg by 5.04 points compared with the reported AV$^2$A values. The same fixed configuration transfers unchanged to OV-AVEBench and VGGSound-AVEL100k.

</details>

*Yizhi Li,Jiawei Jiang,Guanhong Wang,Yingcai Wu,Gaoang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SportsGrounder框架，通过开放词汇视觉专家实现交错式grounding，并配合动作感知监督和混合偏好优化，解决密集体育视频推理中模型过度依赖文本先验而缺乏细粒度视觉理解的问题，在SoccerNet和FineSports衍生数据集上取得SOTA精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集体育视频推理要求对大量小尺度、高交互、视觉同质化实体（如同队服球员、球）进行细粒度理解，而现有LMMs因缺乏细粒度视觉细节，往往过度依赖文本先验去猜测答案，尤其在区分视觉相似的球员和动作时表现不佳。

Method: SportsGrounder包含三个核心组件：(1) Interleaved Grounding Fusion (IGF)机制，逐帧集成显式边界框坐标和隐式视觉语义与全局网格特征，保持严格时间对齐并防止序列长度爆炸；(2) Action-Aware Supervision (AAS)模块，直接正则化模型隐藏状态，强制学习准确运动表征而非依赖语言偏置；(3) Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO)优化策略，更好区分欺骗性干扰项。整体利用开放词汇视觉专家提取领域引导的目标提议以实现在交错式grounding中的精确空间定位。

Result: 在新构建的密集体育VQA数据集（基于SoccerNet和FineSports）上的大量实验表明，SportsGrounder显著提升了细粒度推理能力并取得了最先进的准确率。

Conclusion: 通过视觉引导的grounding、动作感知监督和偏好优化三管齐下的策略，可以有效缓解LMMs在密集体育视频推理中的文本偏置问题，为多模态模型处理高复杂度的密集视觉场景提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Sports video analysis is crucial for athletic analytics and broadcasting enhancement. Dense sports video reasoning, however, demands a fine-grained understanding of numerous small-scale, highly interactive, and visually homogeneous entities (e.g., players sharing identical uniforms, the ball) across long temporal contexts. Current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) inherently struggle with such dense visual complexities. Due to the lack of fine-grained visual details, these models often over-rely on textual priors to guess answers, especially when distinguishing visually similar actions and players. To address this, we propose \textbf{SportsGrounder}, a framework that leverages an open-vocabulary visual expert to aid interleaved grounding specifically for dense sports video reasoning. To achieve precise spatial localization, we extract domain-guided object proposals and introduce an Interleaved Grounding Fusion (IGF) mechanism. The IGF frame-by-frame integrates explicit bounding box coordinates and implicit visual semantics with global grid features. This design preserves strict temporal alignment and prevents sequence length explosion. Furthermore, we design an Action-Aware Supervision (AAS) module that directly regularizes the model's hidden states, forcing the network to learn accurate motion representations rather than relying on language bias. Optimized with Mixed Preference Optimization (MPO) to better distinguish deceptive distractors, our extensive experiments on newly curated dense sports VQA datasets (derived from SoccerNet and FineSports) demonstrate that SportsGrounder significantly improves fine-grained reasoning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy.

</details>


### [57] [FlexSplat: Flexible Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting without Point Cloud Correspondence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07937)
*Amir Sabbaghziarani,Hanting Ye,Maria Gorlatova,Yi Ding*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlexSplat是一个无需相机位姿标定的前馈式新视角合成框架，通过联合训练几何Transformer与高斯解码器，在无标定多视图输入下实现与有标定方法相当的重建质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于查询的3D高斯重建方法（如query-based方法）能够通过多视角可变形注意力重建紧凑的3D高斯集合，但这些方法都假设输入图像具有已知的相机位姿。这种假设在实际场景中往往难以满足，限制了方法的适用性。作者希望移除这一假设，实现无标定（calibration-free）的端到端新视角合成。

Method: FlexSplat由两个核心组件构成：（1）一个几何Transformer，与高斯解码器联合训练，用于预测每张图像的相机参数和深度；（2）一个深度引导的高斯参数化模块和多视角可变形交叉注意力机制，用于跨所有输入视图聚合证据，形成单一的视图一致基元集合。训练中采用不确定性加权的深度一致性目标，使几何前端能自适应重建任务；解码过程中形成的跨视图共识可吸收相机和深度估计的残差误差。高斯预算与输入分辨率及视图数量解耦。

Result: 在ShapeNet-SRN和Google Scanned Objects (GSO)数据集上，FlexSplat在无需相机位姿和真实深度的条件下，匹配或接近有标定最先进重建方法的表现；在GSO上匹配最佳感知质量（LPIPS）。与有标定方法相比，PSNR差距在0.7 dB以内，且达到相当的感知质量。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，联合训练的几何前端足以将无标定操作引入基于查询的高斯重建框架。FlexSplat在紧凑基元表示、分辨率解耦与视图数量无关等特性上延续了query-based方法的优势，同时消除了对相机位姿的先验依赖。

Abstract: We present FlexSplat, a feed-forward framework for novel view synthesis (NVS) from uncalibrated, object-centric multi-view image collections. A recent line of query-based methods reconstructs a compact set of 3D Gaussians by treating them as transformer queries that are refined with multi-view deformable attention; these methods, however, assume that camera poses are given. FlexSplat removes this assumption: a geometry transformer is trained jointly with the Gaussian decoder to predict per-image camera parameters and depth, which in turn ground a depth-guided Gaussian parameterization and a multi-view deformable cross-attention that aggregates evidence across all input views into a single, view-consistent set of primitives. An uncertainty-weighted depth-consistency objective lets the jointly trained geometry adapt to the reconstruction task, while the cross-view consensus formed during decoding absorbs the residual error of the estimated cameras and depth. The representation uses a compact Gaussian budget that is decoupled from the input resolution - unlike pixel-aligned methods, the primitive count does not grow with the image grid - and is not dictated by the number of views. On ShapeNet-SRN and Google Scanned Objects (GSO), FlexSplat matches or approaches posed state-of-the-art reconstructors while requiring neither camera poses nor ground-truth depth, and matches the best perceptual (LPIPS) quality among the compared methods on GSO. Our results indicate that a jointly trained geometry front-end is sufficient to bring calibration-free operation to query-based Gaussian reconstruction while staying within 0.7 dB PSNR of posed methods and matching their perceptual quality.

</details>


### [58] [LAD-COD: Language-Aligned Dense Perception for Camouflaged Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07941)
*Shangye Song,Tianzhi Zhu,Syed Ariff Syed Hesham,Xin He,Yun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LAD-COD是一个用于伪装物体检测（COD）的框架，通过将自顶向下的语义目标引导与自底向上的层次化视觉特征对齐，解决了伪装物体前景-背景可判别性低、边界证据弱的问题，在CAMO、COD10K和NC4K三个数据集的所有12项指标比较中取得了最佳结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伪装物体检测中，目标与周围环境高度相似，导致前景-背景可判别性降低，外观、纹理和结构上的边界证据被削弱。现有基于大型多模态模型（LMMs）的语言到掩码分割系统中，指令条件化的目标嵌入主要仅指导掩码解码器，而缺乏对必须保留低对比度边界和精细局部结构的稠密视觉特征的显式引导，这限制了伪装分割的性能。

Method: LAD-COD提出语言对齐的稠密感知框架，将自顶向下的语义目标引导与自底向上的层次化视觉特征对齐。具体而言：（1）不直接完全适配大型通用图像编码器，而是学习一个可训练的层次化视觉分支，以捕捉伪装敏感的纹理、边界和上下文信息；（2）提出语言对齐双视觉融合模块（LADVF），将目标嵌入从稀疏提示扩展到查询补丁级语言对齐特征，并对其与层次化特征的残差整合进行门控控制。该设计使语义信息能够引导定位，同时保留伪装分割所需的精细结构细节。

Result: 在CAMO、COD10K和NC4K三个基准数据集上进行实验，LAD-COD在所有12个数据集-指标比较（3个数据集 × 4个指标）中均取得了最佳报告值，验证了该方法在伪装物体检测任务上的有效性。

Conclusion: LAD-COD通过语言对齐的稠密感知机制，成功地将语义目标引导融入到层次化视觉特征中，弥补了现有语言到掩码分割范式对稠密视觉特征缺乏显式引导的不足。实验证明该方法在伪装物体检测任务上全面超越了现有方法，为该领域提供了一种有效的新框架。

Abstract: Camouflaged object detection (COD) aims to segment objects that exhibit high visual similarity to their surroundings, which reduces foreground-background discriminability and weakens boundary evidence across appearance, texture, and structure. Such limitations motivate the use of instruction-conditioned semantics as top-down guidance for identifying which weak visual cues are relevant to the target. Recent segmentation systems built on large multimodal models (LMMs) demonstrate this possibility through instruction-conditioned target embeddings that guide mask decoding. However, in this language-to-mask paradigm, the generated target embedding conditions mainly the mask decoder, leaving the dense visual features that must preserve low-contrast boundaries and fine local structure without explicit guidance. We propose Language-Aligned Dense perception for COD (LAD-COD), a framework that aligns top-down semantic target guidance with bottom-up hierarchical visual features. Instead of fully adapting a large generic image encoder, LAD-COD learns a trainable hierarchical visual branch that captures camouflage-sensitive texture, boundary, and contextual information. To align these features with the target embedding, LAD-COD applies Language-Aligned Dual Visual Fusion (LADVF), which extends the embedding beyond sparse prompting to query patch-level language-aligned features and to gate their residual integration with the hierarchical features. This design allows semantic information to guide localization while preserving the fine structural details needed for camouflage segmentation. Experiments on CAMO, COD10K, and NC4K show that LAD-COD obtains the best reported value in all 12 dataset-metric comparisons.

</details>


### [59] [SynVAR: Synergizing Spatial and Semantic Alignment in Visual Autoregressive Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07948)
*Zhennan Chen,Tianxing Shi,Pengcheng Xu,Kepan Nan,Qian Wang,Zili Yi,Jian Yang,Ying Tai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SynVAR是首个针对VAR（视觉自回归）范式设计的训练免费增强框架，通过空间-语义协同控制策略抑制跨尺度误差传播与累积，包含全局引导、感受野约束和高频补偿三个核心组件，显著提升VAR在复杂多物体、多属性场景下的生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VAR因其下一尺度预测范式而广受欢迎，但在处理包含多个物体和属性的复杂场景时存在严重的性能瓶颈。现有基于扩散的增强方法无法有效解决VAR特有的跨尺度误差传播与累积问题，因此亟需一种专门针对VAR范式设计的增强方案。

Method: SynVAR包含三个关键组件：(1) 全局引导（Global guidance），在早期阶段确保合理的空间结构；(2) 感受野约束（Receptive field constraints），缓解早期阶段的语义混淆；(3) 高频补偿（High-frequency compensation），恢复细粒度细节。三者协同构成空间-语义协作控制策略，且无需任何训练。

Result: 大量定量和定性实验表明，SynVAR在增强VAR复杂场景建模能力方面取得了显著改进，有效抑制了跨尺度误差传播并提升了生成质量。

Conclusion: SynVAR作为首个专门针对VAR范式的训练免费增强框架，通过空间-语义协同控制策略有效解决了VAR在复杂场景下的性能瓶颈，为VAR范式提供了通用且高效的增强路径。

Abstract: VAR has gained widespread popularity due to its next-scale prediction paradigm. However, it faces substantial performance bottlenecks when handling complex scenes with multiple objects and attributes. Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods fail to adequately address the unique challenge of cross-scale error propagation and accumulation in VAR. To this end, we propose SynVAR, the first training-free enhancement framework specifically tailored for the VAR paradigm, which introduces a spatial-semantic collaborative control strategy to effectively suppress propagation error and improve generation quality. SynVAR comprises three key components: (1) Global guidance to ensure reasonable spatial structure in the early stages, (2) Receptive field constraints to mitigate early-stage semantic confusion, (3) High-frequency compensation to recover fine-grained details. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the significant improvements in the ability of SynVAR to enhance the VAR's capability for complex scene modeling.

</details>


### [60] [LIBAD: A Multimodal Anomaly Detection Benchmark for Li-Ion Battery Electrode Manufacturing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07958)
*Wenbo Sui,Daniel Lichau,Harold Phelippeau,Zhao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了LIBAD，这是首个面向锂离子电池电极制造的多模态异常检测基准数据集，涵盖双面可见光成像、高分辨率X射线和低分辨率X射线三种模态。作者指出连续流程制造中的弱相关模态导致现有方法迁移性差、误报率高，并提出DA-Core方法，通过联合考虑特征空间覆盖度和正常特征的局部密度进行核心集选择，在0.05核心集比例下将FPR95从60.4%降至54.3%，同时推理时间减少43.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态工业异常检测研究主要聚焦于离散产品，使用强相关的RGB和3D观测数据，而连续流程制造（如电极生产）和弱相关传感模态（如可见光与X射线）尚未被充分探索。实际生产中线内兼容的低分辨率X射线与可见光之间的异常证据存在显著的不一致性，导致现有方法迁移性差且误报率高，亟需新的基准和方法来应对这一挑战。

Method: 本文提出DA-Core（Density-Aware Coreset），一种基于记忆库的异常检测方法。其核心创新在于核心集选择阶段同时考虑特征空间覆盖度和正常特征的局部密度：在保持代表性地采样特征以覆盖特征空间的同时，优先保留局部密度较高的精细正常变化，使紧凑的记忆库能够更好地保留细粒度的正常模式。该方法针对双模态（可见光+低分辨率X射线）的弱相关特征进行联合建模。

Result: 在LIBAD基准上，DA-Core在0.05核心集比例下将FPR95从60.4%降至54.3%，优于标准最远点采样。在此比例下，DA-Core还超过了最优标准核心集结果（在0.20比例下获得），同时推理时间减少了43.9%。实验还验证了代表性方法在LIBAD上迁移性有限且误报率一致偏高。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在连续流程制造场景下，正常特征的数据分布以及模态间关系都需要在设计异常检测方法时被显式考虑。LIBAD及其评测结果揭示了弱相关多模态场景下现有方法面临的独特挑战，DA-Core证明了密度感知的核心集选择是提升性能的有效途径。

Abstract: Multimodal industrial anomaly detection has largely focused on discrete products using strongly correlated RGB and 3D observations, leaving continuous process manufacturing and weakly correlated sensing modalities underexplored. We introduce LIBAD, the first multimodal anomaly detection benchmark for Li-ion battery electrode manufacturing. Collected from real roll-to-roll production lines, LIBAD provides aligned double-sided visible-light imaging, high-resolution X-ray radiography, and inline-compatible low-resolution X-ray radiography. Electrode patches in LIBAD exhibit highly homogeneous material appearance, while defect evidence can be strong in one modality but weak or absent in another, resulting in pronounced cross-modal anomaly inconsistency. Benchmarks of representative methods under the inline-compatible visible-light and low-resolution X-ray setting exhibit limited transferability and consistently high false-positive rates. We therefore propose DA-Core, a memory-based method that jointly considers feature-space coverage and local density of normal features during coreset selection, allowing compact memory banks to better preserve fine-grained normal variations. With a coreset ratio of 0.05, DA-Core reduces FPR95 from 60.4% to 54.3% compared with standard farthest point sampling. At this ratio, DA-Core also outperforms the best standard coreset result (obtained at 0.20) while reducing inference time by 43.9%. These results suggest that both the data distribution of normal features and the modality relationship itself require explicit consideration when designing anomaly detection methods for process manufacturing.

</details>


### [61] [Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07981)
*Liangliang Zhao,Junying Wang,Danni Yang,Yifan Chang,Bin Fu,Yu Qiao,Bowen Zhou,Yihao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhyS是一个三阶段框架，用于将物理先验知识蒸馏到流式世界模型中。它通过构建120K真实物理交互视频数据集（PhyS-120K）注入物理先验到14B双向DiT教师模型，再蒸馏为1.3B因果DiT用于少步自回归流式生成，最后通过在线强化学习（含提出的Temporal Credit Routing机制）优化物理合理性。在PhysicsIQ基准上，PhyS使Wan2.1-14B教师提升18.2%，并使Self Forcing、Rolling Forcing和Causal Forcing分别提升23.7%、14.8%和31.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流式世界模型虽然能在长时程内维持连贯的物理动态，但其rollout常常违反基本物理约束。当前主流的蒸馏范式（将预训练双向DiT蒸馏为少步因果生成器）存在两个根本局限：一是通用的双向教师模型从视觉预训练中获得的物理先验有限；二是这些有限的先验在双向到因果的蒸馏过程中进一步损失。因此需要一种系统化的方法来解决物理先验的获取与保持问题。

Method: PhyS采用三阶段框架：(1) 构建PhyS-120K数据集，包含120K真实世界物理交互视频，覆盖刚体动力学、软体变形、流体现象和相变四大物理类型，每个视频带有物体属性和因果状态转换的结构化标注。(2) 利用物理感知的有监督微调将物理先验注入14B双向DiT教师模型，随后蒸馏为轻量级1.3B因果DiT用于少步自回归流式生成。(3) 通过在线强化学习激励蒸馏模型生成物理合理的rollout，并提出Temporal Credit Routing (TCR)机制来解决时序信用分配问题——TCR在重叠时间窗口上评估物理一致性，并将组相对优势路由到时间对齐的去噪动作上。

Result: 在PhysicsIQ基准上，PhyS使Wan2.1-14B教师模型提升18.2%，使Self Forcing、Rolling Forcing和Causal Forcing三种方法分别提升23.7%、14.8%和31.4%。此外，在物理学感知的视频基准VideoPhy、VideoPhy2和PhyGenBench上也取得了改进。

Conclusion: PhyS通过"数据收集-教师注入-轻量蒸馏-强化学习优化"的系统化流程，有效解决了流式世界模型中物理先验获取不足和蒸馏过程中先验损失两个关键问题，显著提升了模型生成物理合理rollout的能力，并在多个基准上验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation. We present PhyS, a three-stage framework for distilling physical priors into streaming world models. To acquire physical priors from real-world interactions, we construct PhyS-120K, a dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos spanning rigid-body dynamics, soft-body deformation, fluid phenomena, and phase transitions. Each video is annotated with structured descriptions of object properties and causal state transitions. Physics-aware supervised fine-tuning injects the physical priors into a bidirectional 14B DiT teacher, which we then distill into a lightweight 1.3B causal DiT for few-step autoregressive streaming generation. Finally, we use online reinforcement learning to incentivize the distilled model to generate physically plausible rollouts and further propose Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) to address temporal credit assignment. TCR evaluates physical consistency over overlapping temporal windows and routes the resulting group-relative advantages to temporally aligned denoising actions. On PhysicsIQ, PhyS improves the Wan2.1-14B teacher by 18.2\% and the Self Forcing, Rolling Forcing, and Causal Forcing by 23.7\%, 14.8\%, and 31.4\%, respectively. Results also improve the physics-aware video benchmarks VideoPhy, VideoPhy2, and PhyGenBench. The dataset, code, and more sample videos are available on our Project Page.

</details>


### [62] [AdaDINO: Pair-Aware In-Backbone Adaptation of Frozen DINO for Efficient Remote Sensing Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07982)
*Xu Zhang,Xinqing Li,Jianpeng Xie,Zeshuai Zhu,Xin He,Yun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdaDINO是一个面向遥感变化检测的pair-aware骨干网络适配框架，通过在冻结的DINO编码器中引入双时相交互（CGLA模块），并结合Batch-Shared Chunk Selection减少计算量，以及CGLA引导的精化解码器实现粗到细预测。在四个遥感变化检测基准上达到或超越现有VFM方法，去除62.5% FFN隐藏宽度后仍取得85.29%的F1分数（SYSU-CD），并获得1.41倍吞吐加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉基础模型（如DINO）是为单图像表示预训练的，而遥感变化检测需要对双时相图像对进行推理。现有VFM方法通常独立编码两幅图像，之后再进行比较，导致VFM骨干网络无法感知跨时相关系，存在域失配问题。

Method: AdaDINO包含三个核心组件：1) Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA)：在选定的冻结块之后耦合双流，以相反符号注入共享的时间残差，增强真实变化响应同时保持图像对中点不变；2) Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS)：通过保留batch共享的通道块子集减少前馈网络（FFN）计算量，可作为紧凑稠密FFN执行；3) CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR)解码器：复用编码器侧的变化响应进行粗到细的预测。

Result: 在四个遥感变化检测基准上，AdaDINO达到或超越了基于VFM的基线方法，在类别无关的SYSU-CD数据集上取得最大增益。去除62.5%的FFN隐藏宽度后，AdaDINO在SYSU-CD上仍获得85.29%的F1分数，同时实现1.41倍吞吐加速。

Conclusion: AdaDINO证明了通过in-backbone的pair-aware适配可以使冻结的VFM骨干有效服务于遥感变化检测任务，在保持高效计算的同时实现优异的检测性能，且代码将开源。

Abstract: Vision foundation models (VFMs) such as DINO are pretrained for single-image representation, whereas remote sensing change detection requires reasoning over a bi-temporal pair. Existing VFM-based methods usually encode the two images independently and compare them only afterward, leaving the VFM backbone unaware of cross-temporal relations. To bridge this mismatch, we present AdaDINO, a pair-aware in-backbone adaptation framework that equips a frozen DINO encoder with bi-temporal interaction for efficient change detection. Its core component, Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA), couples the two streams after selected frozen blocks and injects a shared temporal residual into them with opposite signs, enhancing genuine change responses while preserving the pair midpoint. Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS) further reduces feed-forward network (FFN) computation by retaining a batch-shared subset of channel chunks that can be executed as a compact dense FFN. A CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR) decoder reuses encoder-side change responses for coarse-to-fine prediction. Experiments on four remote sensing change detection benchmarks show that AdaDINO achieves competitive or superior performance against VFM-based baselines, with the largest gain on the category-agnostic SYSU-CD dataset. With 62.5% of the FFN hidden width removed, AdaDINO still achieves an F1 score of 85.29% on SYSU-CD while delivering a 1.41$\times$ throughput speedup. The code will be released.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 构建了由17个公开数据源整合而成的AgriField-40K田间中心数据集；提出AgriMAE参数高效持续预训练基线，仅训练轻量适配器来适配自然图像预训练的掩码自编码器；并与语义特征重构预训练目标进行对比，在多个下游任务上评估迁移效果。
