This formulation separates \emph{where} the adaptive target is placed from \emph{how} the student is projected toward it: the interpolation coefficient controls underlying target, while the Rényi order controls the projection geometry and its sensitivity to token-level density ratios. Extensive experiments across scientific evaluation, mathematical reasoning, and coding generation tasks with multiple large language models show that SR-OPSD achieves the state-of-the-art or competitive performance across various settings.

</details>


### [430] [MoNo: Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on General Geometries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09764)
*Zijiang Yang,Xiaomeng Wu,Dongmei Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MoNo，一种基于最优传输的多尺度神经算子，通过CoTAP机制解决潜在空间中token分配不平衡与层级坍缩问题，在PDE求解上兼顾性能与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的神经算子在将空间观测投影为潜在token时，可学习的投影机制无法保证观测点向潜在token的稳定、均衡分配，导致部分token过分配而部分欠利用；这种不平衡在多尺度层级架构中会被逐层继承并放大，最终引发深层空间的严重token坍缩。

Method: 提出MoNo（多尺度最优传输神经算子），其核心是CoTAP（跨尺度最优传输分配与投影）方法：将相邻潜在空间之间的跨空间分配建模为熵正则化的最优传输问题，从而构建均衡的双向投影与稳定的潜在空间；CoTAP保证多尺度潜在空间间的稳定信息传递，支持在通用几何上构建多尺度架构，以高效学习长程物理交互。

Result: 大量实验表明，MoNo在预测性能和计算效率两方面均优于现有最先进的神经算子（state-of-the-art），代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过将潜在空间构建形式化为最优传输问题，MoNo有效解决了token分配不均匀和历史层级坍缩问题，为Transformer类神经算子在通用几何上的多尺度设计提供了稳健的潜在空间构建范式。

Abstract: Transformer-based neural operators have achieved substantial progress in solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) by projecting spatial observations into compact latent tokens and learning physical interactions in latent spaces. However, we reveal that existing learnable projection mechanisms cannot ensure stable and balanced assignments from observation points to latent tokens, causing some latent tokens to be over-assigned while others remain underutilized. This limitation further restricts the design of hierarchical architectures, as assignment imbalance is continuously inherited and amplified across latent spaces, eventually causing severe token collapse in deeper spaces. To address these issues, we propose MoNo (Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator), a progressive multiscale neural operator that efficiently solves PDEs on general geometries through stable latent-space construction. At its core is CoTAP (Cross-scale Optimal Transport Assignment and Projection), a novel latent-space construction method that formulates cross-space assignment between adjacent spaces as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby constructing balanced bidirectional projections and stable latent spaces. CoTAP also ensures stable information transfer across multiple latent spaces, further enabling multiscale architectures on general geometries, which in turn support more efficient learning of long-range physical interactions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MoNo outperforms existing state-of-the-art neural operators in both prediction performance and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/ZijiangY1116/MoNo.

</details>


### [431] [ReliableNet: A Chance-Constrained Approach to Trustworthy Classification in Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09768)
*Ange-Clément Akazan,Ineza Remy Mugenga,Abebe Geletu,Jean Medard Ngnotchouye,Issa Karambal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReliableNet方法，将"自信但错误"（JCW）联合事件概率约束在用户指定的风险预算α内，将问题形式化为机会约束ERM并采用保守光滑内逼近求解。在多个数据集和分布偏移场景下，ReliableNet是唯一在所有数据集和随机种子下均能在分布内满足JCW预算的方法，并保持较好的准确性、覆盖率、校准和选择性预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自信且错误的预测是严重的可靠性失效——它恰恰在模型出错时绕过弃权（abstention）和人工审核机制。现有方法（如ERM、校准、不确定性估计、共形风险控制、选择性预测）分别控制平均值损失或相关可靠性性质，但都没有直接在训练过程中约束"自信且错误"这一联合失效事件的发生概率。

Method: 1) 将问题形式化为机会约束ERM（chance-constrained ERM），直接约束联合自信-错误（JCW）概率低于用户指定的风险预算α∈(0,1)。2) 使用保守的光滑内逼近（conservative smooth inner approximation）来处理该约束，其总体可行性蕴含原始JCW约束的满足。

Result: 在4个表格数据集和2个图像数据集上，与ERM、事后校准、共形风险控制和选择性预测等基线方法相比，ReliableNet是唯一在所有数据集和随机种子下均能在分布内认证满足JCW预算的方法。在人口统计、模糊性、虚假相关、新类别和协变量偏移等分布偏移场景下，它在各方法中取得最低的经验JCW，同时在准确性、覆盖率、校准和选择性预测方面保持很强的竞争力。风险-覆盖（risk-coverage）结果还显示其在大多数数据集上优于基线方法的选择性排序性能。

Conclusion: ReliableNet为可信分类提供了一种有原则性的（principled）方法，能够直接训练期间约束模型在自信时出错的联合失效概率，从而弥补了现有可靠性方法在该关键失效模式上的空白。

Abstract: A prediction that is both confident and wrong is a critical reliability failure because it can bypass abstention and human review precisely when the model is mistaken. Empirical risk minimization (ERM) controls average loss but not this failure directly, while calibration, uncertainty estimation, conformal risk control, and selective prediction methods target related reliability properties rather than bounding the joint failure event during training. We propose ReliableNet, which constrains the Joint Confident-Wrong (JCW) probability, the probability that a prediction is simultaneously confident and incorrect, below a user-specified risk budget $α\in(0,1)$. We formulate this as a chance-constrained ERM problem, use a conservative smooth inner approximation whose population feasibility implies the original JCW constraint. Across four tabular and two image datasets, ReliableNet is the only method certified within the JCW budget for every dataset and seed in distribution, when compared against baselines spanning ERM, post-hoc calibration, conformal risk control, and selective prediction. Under demographic, ambiguity, spurious-correlation, novel-class, and covariate shifts, it achieves the lowest empirical JCW among the compared methods while remaining very competitive in accuracy, coverage, calibration, and selective prediction. Risk-coverage results further indicate that ReliableNet achieves better selective ranking than the benchmark methods on most datasets. Overall, ReliableNet provides a principled approach to trustworthy classification.

</details>


### [432] [Parameter Exploration for RLVR via Variational Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09805)
*Vatsal Venkatkrishna,Nico Daheim,Iryna Gurevych*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出参数空间探索方法家族Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO)，通过在rollout生成时从后验中采样不同策略（而非仅在动作空间调节温度）来增强LLM强化学习中的探索，在数学推理和代码生成任务上优于标准GRPO且FLOPs开销几乎相同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM强化学习中的探索主要在动作空间进行（如温度缩放），但这类方法无法重新排序token，只能影响输出分布的方差，限制了探索能力，可能导致训练发散或停滞。作者希望探索参数空间这一互补的控制维度，以改善探索效率和训练稳定性。

Method: 提出3PO方法家族，包含不同的参数采样策略（如从后验中采样不同多样性的策略）和不同的rollout分组方式用于奖励估计。具体而言，rollouts由从后验中采样的不同策略生成，通过调节策略采样的多样性作为探索控制杠杆，并将其与reward estimation的grouping策略相结合。

Result: 在OLMo-3-1025-7B和Qwen2.5-Math-7B上的数学推理与代码生成实验中，3PO方法在近相同FLOPs成本下持续优于标准GRPO的平均下游性能。使用多个参数采样时，训练中的零优势组（zero-advantage groups）和格式错误或错误rollout数量明显少于GRPO及动作空间基线。

Conclusion: 参数空间探索能够有效提升LLM的强化学习性能，为探索策略提供了动作空间之外的全新控制维度，为LLM强化学习优化提供了一种补充性且有效的方法。

Abstract: Exploration has been a focus of reinforcement learning research for a long time. Recently, there has been growing evidence that it is also an important ingredient in LLM reinforcement learning recipes that can significantly impact downstream performance. Many existing methods control exploration in the action-space, for example, using temperature scaling. However, these methods cannot reorder tokens but only influence the variance in the output distribution. This limits exploration and can lead to divergence or stalled training. Here, we investigate parameter-space exploration, where rollouts are generated by sampling different policies from a posterior that may each explore different rollouts. Sampling less or more diverse policies is then a complementary control lever over exploration. We introduce a family of methods called Perturbed Parameter Policy Optimization (3PO) which use different sampling strategies and different rollout grouping for reward estimation. Experiments on OLMo-3-1025-7B and Qwen2.5-Math-7B across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks show that these approaches consistently improve average downstream performance over standard GRPO at a near-identical FLOPs cost. Moreover, using multiple parameter samples consistently produces fewer zero-advantage groups and malformed or incorrect rollouts during training than GRPO and action-space baselines. Overall, our work presents evidence that parameter-space exploration can improve reinforcement learning for LLMs.

</details>


### [433] [Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09819)
*Mind Lab,:,Vin Bo,Asher Cai,Jingwei Cao,Song Cao,Vic Cao,Amelia Chen,Andrew Chen,Kaijie Chen,Cleon Cheng,Steven Chiang,Kaixuan Fan,Hera Feng,Huan Feng,Arthur Fu,Jun Gao,Pyke Han,Nolan Ho,Ori Hong,Hailee Hou,Piers Hua,Charles Huang,Miles Jiang,Nora Jiang,Yuyi Jiang,Qiuyu Jin,Fancy Kong,Kuss Koo,Jaron Lee,Andrew Lei,Alexy Li,Dawn Li,Lucian Li,Ray Li,Ricardo Li,Smith Li,Theo Li,Allen Lin,Elliot Lin,Fan Lin,Chen Ling,Kairus Liu,Kieran Liu,Logan Liu,Neo Liu,Xiang Liu,Yuxin Lu,Maeve Luo,Pony Ma,Verity Niu,Cole Qiao,Guian Qiu,Vince Qu,Sentry,Niko Song,Vincent Wang,Bo Wu,Rio Yang,Evelyn Ye,Fiona Ye,Ina Ye,Regis Ye,Josh Ying,Atlas Zeng,Danney Zeng,Salmon Zhan,Anya Zhang,Di Zhang,Mia Zhang,Sueky Zhang,Wei Zhao,Ada Zhou,Adrian Zhou,Yuhua Zhou,Juno Zhu,Murphy Zhuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Macaron-V1是一个面向"体验智能"（从真实环境经验中学习并在部署后持续学习）的开源智能体模型家族，通过自适应递归改进与协同的Mixture-of-LoRA（MoL）架构实现。旗舰版Macaron-V1-Venti以744B GLM-5.2为基座结合4个LoRA适配器，另有本地部署版Tall（50B）。系统涵盖架构、算法和基础设施三个层面的协同设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大模型通常在训练后冻结，缺乏从真实环境体验中持续学习的能力。论文旨在构建一个能"从经验中学习"并"部署后持续进化"的开放智能体模型家族，以弥补传统模型无法适应环境变化和知识更新的局限。

Method: 论文提出两大系统目标：(1) 自适应——通过递归改进版本化的模型-测试平台（model-harness）配对，将外部契约评估的经验用于构建下一代模型；(2) 协同——采用Mixture-of-LoRA（MoL）架构，冻结基座模型、组合专家LoRA适配器、每用户轮次选择一个LoRA。算法层面包含Model-Harness协同设计与递归自改进循环，引入UI4A组件原生GenUI测试平台、有状态动作基板、版本化HCP契约，以及基于智能体RL框架MindForge的方法。基础设施包括后训练平台MinT、长上下文RL方法LongStraw，以及针对稀疏MoE和DSA基座模型的稳定性技术。

Result: 在Personal Intelligence、GenUI和通用能力基准上与前沿基线对比评估Macaron-V1，结果验证了当前系统的有效性。但持续学习和集体智能带来的复合收益仍是开放问题。

Conclusion: Macaron-V1验证了"体验智能"路线的可行性：通过MoL架构实现可持续学习，通过递归改进实现自适应。当前系统的有效性得到基准验证，但持续学习与集体智能的长期compound增益尚未充分显现，是未来探索方向。

Abstract: Macaron-V1 is an open agent-model family for experiential intelligence: learning from experience in real environments and continuing to learn after deployment. It is organized around two system goals. Adaptation is pursued through recursive improvement of versioned model-harness pairs, where experience from one configuration is evaluated under an external contract and used to construct its successor. Collaboration is pursued via the Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) architecture that freezes a base model, composes specialist LoRA adapters, and selects one LoRA per user turn. The flagship Macaron-V1-Venti combines a 744B GLM-5.2 base with four LoRAs for chat, agent, coding, and GenUI; the Qwen3.6-based Macaron-V1-Tall (50B) uses the same design for local deployment. This report presents Macaron-V1 as a co-designed system spanning architecture, algorithms, and infrastructure. The MoL architecture supports continual learning through extensible LoRA specialists. The algorithm combines Model-Harness Co-design and recursive self-improvement loop, including the UI4A component-native GenUI harness, a stateful action substrate, versioned HCP contract, and the agentic RL framework MindForge. The supporting infrastructure includes the post-training platform MinT, the long-context RL method LongStraw, and stability techniques for sparse MoE and DSA base models. We evaluate Macaron-V1 on Personal Intelligence, GenUI, and general capability benchmarks against frontier baselines. Our results validate the current system, while compounding gains from continual learning and collective intelligence remain open questions.

</details>


### [434] [Distill Skills into Weights, Not Prompts: Abstract Skills as Privileged Signals for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09826)
*Yubo Jiang,Fengying Xie,Zhiguo Jiang,Haopeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SKALD（技能锚定潜在蒸馏）框架，解决强化学习在验证奖励全部正确或全部错误的rollout组中缺乏组间相对信号的问题（此类组占实验中的63.0-68.0%），通过利用抽象技能卡片对学生模型进行自蒸馏监督。在0.6B、1.7B和4B规模下，相比GRPO在五个数学基准上分别提升+2.46、+4.85和+12.01的avg@8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（如GRPO）依赖组内相对信号进行训练，但当rollout组中所有样本都正确或都错误时（占63.0-68.0%的组），没有组间相对差异可用于学习，导致这些数据对训练无贡献。需要一种不依赖组相对信号、能够从均匀正确或均匀错误的组中提取监督信号的方法。

Method: SKALD采用on-policy自蒸馏框架，使用Qwen3-Base模型的两种上下文视图：仅输入问题的学生模型，以及以抽象、显式答案过滤的技能卡片为条件输入的教师模型。学生模型在自己的前缀上进行训练，将技能诱导的优势迁移到共享参数中，测试时无需特权输入。为稳定上下文导致的分布失配，采用退火指数倾斜目标函数，对低学生似然的教师偏好token降权；退火消失时收敛到教师交叉熵并恢复前向KL学生梯度。此外，通过经验门控机制，仅在验证rollout估计出正向教师优势时激活蒸馏。

Result: 在五个保留的数学基准上，SKALD相比GRPO在0.6B、1.7B和4B规模下avg@8分别提升+2.46、+4.85和+12.01。在1.7B规模下，仅使用零方差组进行蒸馏即可恢复完整增益的84.7%；SKALD相比FLOP匹配的GRPO高出+4.06，并超过上下文技能暴露方法+3.77。

Conclusion: 抽象技能能够提供密集的监督信号，弥补组相对奖励在均匀正确/错误组中失效的问题，显著提升数学推理能力。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards yields no group-relative signal when rollout groups are uniformly correct or uniformly wrong, which account for 63.0-68.0% of groups in our experiments. We propose SKALD (Skill-Anchored Latent Distillation), an on-policy self-distillation framework that uses two context views of the same Qwen3-Base model: a question-only student and a teacher conditioned on an abstract, explicit-answer-filtered skill card. The student is trained on its own prefixes, transferring the skill-induced advantage into shared parameters without privileged input at test time. To stabilize context-induced distribution mismatch, SKALD employs an annealed exponentially tilted objective that downweights teacher-preferred tokens with very low student likelihood; as the tilt vanishes, it converges to teacher cross-entropy and recovers the forward-KL student gradient. An empirical gate activates distillation only when verified rollouts estimate a positive teacher advantage. Across five held-out mathematics benchmarks, SKALD improves overall avg@8 over GRPO by +2.46, +4.85, and +12.01 at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, respectively. At 1.7B, zero-variance-only distillation recovers 84.7% of the full gain, while SKALD remains +4.06 above FLOP-matched GRPO and exceeds contextual skill exposure by +3.77. These results show that abstract skills provide dense supervision where group-relative rewards become uninformative.

</details>


### [435] [Multi-Agent AI Safety as an Institutional Design Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09828)
*Abdullah X*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是POLIS研究计划的首篇论文，通过5,280个情节的系统性实验研究AI机构中的安全机制。研究发现，宪政提示（constitutional prompt）和可溯源执行守卫（provenance-aware guard）均实现0/384违规，而基于局部状态的守卫在洗钱场景中失败率显著更高（22/96 vs 0/96，p=4.77×10⁻⁷），表明机构安全不仅取决于规则本身，还取决于系统信任的权威状态和被阻塞后的可用路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理越来越多地在系统中工作，这些系统管理其任务委派、信息流动、动作执行和共享资源的使用。已有研究表明部署规则可以改变集体行为，但尚未系统回答：AI机构的哪些部分产生安全性，以及它们如何实现安全性？

Method: 采用冻结的5,280个情节的研究套件。主预设委派实验覆盖四个模型家族，另加三个模型端点用于高冲突诊断。在匹配的结构化工作流中，模型看到不同的规则表述，守卫咨询不同的权威状态；同时变化即时合规内部/自我回退的吸引力，并允许被阻塞的工作流继续。比较了宪政提示、可溯源执行守卫和局部状态守卫三种机制的性能。

Result: 宪政提示产生0/384实际违规；可溯源执行守卫同样0/384违规，但在51/384情节中阻止了被禁止的尝试，其中44/51后续安全完成。局部状态守卫的失败集中在普通变换改变可见政策而原始权威保持不变的场景。在匹配的洗钱场景中，局部状态守卫在22/96情节中允许违规，而可溯源执行守卫为0/96（p=4.77×10⁻⁷）。资源分配实验显示揭示相同上限的数值会改变代理请求。

Conclusion: 在结构化工作流中，相同的最终违规率可能隐藏完全不同的机制。规则本身只是机构的一部分——系统信任的权威状态至关重要，被阻塞后的可用路径也同样重要。这为算法化AI机构的设计提供了实证基础。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly work inside systems that govern how they delegate tasks, move information, execute actions, and use shared resources. Recent work already shows that deployment rules can change collective behavior. Here we ask which parts of an AI institution produce safety and how they do it. This is the first paper from POLIS, an ongoing research programme studying algorithmic institutions for multi-agent systems. We report a frozen 5,280-episode study suite. The main pre-specified delegation experiment spans four model families; a targeted high-conflict diagnostic adds three additional model endpoints. In matched structured workflows, the model sees different rule formulations and guards consult different authority states. We also vary the attractiveness of the immediate compliant internal/self fallback and allow blocked workflows to continue. A detailed constitutional prompt produces 0/384 realized violations. A provenance-aware executable guard also produces 0/384, although it blocks prohibited attempts in 51/384 episodes; 44/51 of those episodes later complete safely. The local-state guard's failures concentrate in scenarios where an ordinary transformation changes visible policy while originating authority stays fixed. In matched laundering scenarios, that guard admits violations in 22/96 episodes and provenance enforcement in 0/96 (p = 4.77 x 10^-7). A separate resource-allocation experiment shows that revealing the numerical value of an otherwise identical cap changes agent requests. In these structured workflows, the same final violation rate can hide very different mechanisms. The rule itself is only part of the institution. The authority state the system trusts matters, and so does the path available after a block.

</details>


### [436] [Deep Multimodal Wearable Sensor Fusion for Detection of Body-Focused Repetitive Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09830)
*Samaneh Rezaeimanesh,Mohsen Behradfar,Mohammad Fili,Guiping Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于腕戴式传感器数据的多模态深度学习框架，用于检测和分类身体聚焦重复行为（如拔头发、抓皮肤）。框架结合CNN与GRU、模态自编码器和晚期融合分类器，在二分类检测中达到F1=0.985、AUC=0.997，在九分类任务中达到宏平均F1=0.700、AUC=0.963，并利用SHAP可解释性分析揭示了时间飞行和惯性模态的主导判别作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身体聚焦重复行为（如拔发、抓皮）是与强迫症和焦虑障碍相关的强迫性运动行为，但由于动作细微且与普通非病理手势重叠，早期客观检测非常困难，亟需一种准确的目标检测方法。

Method: 采用多模态深度学习框架：结合卷积神经网络（CNN）与门控循环单元（GRU）提取时空动力学特征，配合模态特定的自编码器以及晚期融合分类器；使用Child Mind Institute通过Helios腕戴设备采集的数据，涵盖惯性测量单元（IMU）、热电堆传感器和飞行时间传感器，融合运动学、热学和近距信息。

Result: 二分类检测F1分数为0.985，ROC曲线下面积（AUC）为0.997；九分类方案（区分每个特定行为与单一分组的非目标类）的宏平均F1分数为0.700，AUC为0.963，优于单模态基线。SHAP可解释性分析显示飞行时间和惯性模态在判别力上占主导地位，层次聚类表明误分类主要由手势的解剖区域驱动。

Conclusion: 多模态传感器融合能够实现准确、客观、连续的行为监测，为实时可穿戴辅助心理健康诊断和个性化干预奠定了基础，展示了在生物医学研究和临床护理中的潜在应用价值。

Abstract: Body-focused repetitive behaviors, such as hair pulling and skin picking, are compulsive motor actions commonly associated with obsessive-compulsive and anxiety disorders. Their early, objective detection remains difficult because the movements are subtle and overlap with ordinary, non-pathological gestures. We developed and evaluated a multimodal deep learning framework to detect and classify these behaviors from wrist-worn sensor data. The data, collected by the Child Mind Institute using the Helios wrist-worn device, combine inertial measurement units, thermopile sensors, and time-of-flight sensors, capturing kinematic, thermal, and proximity information. The framework combined a convolutional neural network with a gated recurrent unit, alongside modality-specific autoencoders and a late-fusion classifier, to exploit temporal and spatial dynamics. It achieved an F1 score of 0.985 and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.997 for binary detection, distinguishing these behaviors from other activities, and a macro-averaged F1 score of 0.700 with an area under the curve of 0.963 across a nine-class scheme that distinguished each individual behavior from a single grouped Non-Target class, improving over single-modality baselines. Post-hoc interpretability based on Shapley additive explanations showed that the time-of-flight and inertial modalities dominated discriminative power by capturing spatial proximity and dynamic movement, while hierarchical clustering indicated that misclassifications were driven primarily by the anatomical region of the gesture. These findings demonstrate that multimodal sensor fusion enables accurate, objective, and continuous behavioral monitoring. This work establishes a foundation for real-time, wearable-assisted mental health diagnostics and personalized interventions in biomedical research and clinical care.

</details>


### [437] [Real-Time Climate Risk Assessment for Supply Chain Resilience: A Data-Driven Nowcasting Framework for Colombian Agriculture](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09846)
*Hernan J. Silva-Sosa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于数据驱动的实时气候风险评估方法论框架，将短期气候预报（nowcasting）与供应链风险建模相结合，用于增强哥伦比亚农业供应链的韧性。原型系统在受控计算环境中得到验证，证明短期降水预报可转化为可操作的供应链风险指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 哥伦比亚农业部门面临不规律降雨、温度波动和极端天气事件的显著影响，尤其对时效敏感型作物冲击巨大。现有的气候风险评估方法未能有效将短期气候预报与供应链决策相集成，缺乏面向利益相关者的早期预警系统，亟需一种结合气候预测与供应链风险管理的综合框架。

Method: 提出一个集成框架，包含三个核心部分：（1）基于历史气象观测的短期气候预报模块；（2）基于显式风险映射、阈值分类和面向利益相关者的风险信号的供应链风险建模模块；（3）概念性早期预警系统架构。在受控计算环境中开发原型实现，使用官方统计和再分析产品的时间序列数据验证，无需依赖卫星影像或计算机视觉组件。

Result: 基于合成数据和历史数据的实验表明，短期降水预测能够有效转化为农业供应链的可操作风险指标，支持库存管理、采购和运输等前瞻性决策。原型系统在受控环境中成功展示了框架的可行性。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了将气候预报与供应链风险建模无缝集成的可行性，为农业供应链利益相关者提供了基于预报的风险早期预警手段，可支撑前瞻性的库存、采购和运输决策，从而增强供应链韧性。

Abstract: This paper presents a methodological framework for real-time climate risk assessment using data-driven nowcasting techniques to enhance supply chain resilience in Colombian agricultural contexts. Climate variability in Colombia, characterized by irregular rainfall, temperature fluctuations, and recurrent extreme events, has a direct impact on agricultural production and logistics, particularly for time sensitive crops. The proposed approach integrates short term climate forecasting based on historical meteorological observations with supply chain risk modeling to establish a conceptual early warning system architecture. A prototype implementation developed in a controlled computational environment demonstrates the feasibility of the framework using historical meteorological and agricultural time series derived from official statistics and reanalysis products, without reliance on satellite imagery or computer vision components. The methodology addresses the integration of climate nowcasting with supply chain decision making through explicit risk mapping, threshold-based categorization, and stakeholder-oriented risk signals. Results from synthetic and historical data experiments indicate that short term precipitation nowcasts can be translated into actionable risk indicators for agricultural supply chains, supporting anticipatory decisions related to inventory, sourcing, and transport.

</details>


### [438] [Fairness in Link Prediction Beyond Demographic Parity: A Reproducibility Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09899)
*Valentijn Oldenburg,Floris de Kam,Stef de Wildt,Jarno Nilson Balk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文复现并验证了Mattos等人(2025)的论断：在公平排序链接预测中，人口统计均等（Δ_DP）指标因忽略链接在排名中的位置而无法检测曝光偏差；而排序感知的归一化折扣KL散度（NDKL）能够检测此类偏差。同时复现了MORAL后处理方法在提升曝光公平性方面的有效性，并通过合成同质性场景、类别型敏感属性以及更多公平性与效用指标（含AWRF）进行了稳健性评估。最终发布修正版可复现实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平排序链接预测中广泛使用的Δ_DP指标仅关注聚合层面的公平性，无法捕捉链接在排名中的位置差异所导致的曝光偏差（exposure bias）。因此需要验证该局限性，并评估更精细的排序感知公平指标（如NDKL）及后处理方法（如MORAL）的有效性与稳健性。

Method: 通过复现实验验证Δ_DP在子群对链接系统性排名较低时仍可能显示聚合均衡；采用NDKL检测此类排序层面的曝光不均；复现MORAL后处理方法，并在合成同质性设置、类别型敏感属性等多样化场景下，配合子群对适配的Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF)等多种公平性与效用指标进行稳健性评估。

Result: 实验结果表明，曝光导向的指标（如NDKL、AWRF）能揭示被Δ_DP掩盖的偏差；MORAL能够在多类数据集和设置下以极小的效用损失显著减少曝光公平性偏差。

Conclusion: 研究确认了Δ_DP在曝光公平性检测中的不足，证实了排序感知公平指标的必要性，并验证了MORAL方法在不同场景下的可推广性与稳健性，同时提供了修正后的可复现开源实现。

Abstract: In fair ranked link prediction, demographic parity ($Δ_\mathrm{DP}$) is a common fairness metric. Yet, Mattos et al. (2025) argue that it fails to detect exposure bias because it ignores where links appear in the ranking. In this study, we reproduce this claim by showing that $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ can indicate aggregate parity even when some subgroup-pair links are systematically ranked lower than others. The proposed rank-aware Normalized Discounted KL-divergence (NDKL), however, does detect such disparities. We also reproduce the effectiveness of MORAL, a post-processing method that improves exposure-based fairness while maintaining competitive utility. Beyond reproduction, we assess robustness using synthetic homophily settings, categorical sensitive attributes, and additional fairness and utility metrics, including subgroup-pair-adapted Attention-Weighted Rank Fairness (AWRF). Overall, our results show that exposure-based metrics uncover biases hidden by $Δ_\mathrm{DP}$ and that MORAL reduces these biases with minimal utility loss across diverse settings and datasets. We release a corrected, reproducible implementation at https://github.com/Floris93100/reproducing-MORAL.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [439] [HINT: Toward an Executable Hardware-Intent Representation Layer for LLM-Driven RTL Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07625)
*Tairan Cheng,Yi Liu,Dongsheng Zuo,Zhengyuan Shi,Hongji Zhang,Xiangfei Hu,Maoshuo He,Hao Yan,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出HINT，一个可执行的硬件意图中间表示层，位于行为规格/可执行oracle与RTL之间，使微架构决策显式化、支持RTL前的检查并提供明确的RTL降级义务。在7个算子案例中全部生成符合契约的可综合RTL，面积比人工RTL减少5.0%-26.2%，比直接C2RTL减少8.9%-86.1%，并在AES、SDC和Vortex VPU等复杂设计上验证了其能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接使用LLM生成实现级质量的RTL仍然困难，因为直接生成需要同时解决微架构决策并产出和调试底层代码，这两项任务耦合导致生成质量不稳定且难以收敛。

Method: 提出HINT中间表示层，将行为级规格与RTL完全解耦：HINT显式化RTL相关的微架构决策，支持在RTL之前进行功能检查，并提供明确的RTL降级义务（即从HINT到RTL需要完成的具体步骤），支持单智能体最小流程和全分阶段工作流两种评估模式。

Result: 在7个算子案例中，HINT介导流程在无后综合QoR优化下7/7成功生成契约合规的可综合RTL；直接C2RTL为5/5，直接C2HLSC仅1/5。HINT在相同Design Compiler综合条件下，面积较五个人工RTL实现减少5.0%-26.2%，较五个被接受的直接C2RTL结果减少8.9%-86.1%。RealBench AES和SDC以及Vortex VPU（综合面积561.67k μm²）进一步验证了规格驱动、协议丰富、存储丰富和层次化设计的能力。

Conclusion: HINT介导的路线比直接RTL生成具有更好的收敛性和实现质量，避免了直接生成中常见的严重实现质量退化问题，为LLM驱动的硬件生成提供了更可靠的中间表示范式。

Abstract: Generating implementation-quality RTL with large language models (LLMs) remains difficult because direct generation must resolve microarchitecture while simultaneously producing and debugging low-level code. We present HINT, an executable hardware-intent intermediate representation layer between behavioral specifications or executable oracles and RTL. HINT makes RTL-relevant microarchitecture explicit, supports pre-RTL checking, and supplies explicit RTL-lowering obligations. We evaluate HINT using both a minimal single-agent flow and a full staged workflow. Across seven operator cases, the HINT-mediated route, with no post-synthesis QoR refinement, produces contract-compliant synthesizable RTL on 7/7 cases; Direct C2RTL and C2HLSC apply to five cases and succeed on 5/5 and 1/5, respectively. Under matched Design Compiler synthesis, HINT reduces area by 5.0\%--26.2\% relative to five manual RTL implementations and by 8.9\%--86.1\% relative to five accepted Direct C2RTL results. RealBench AES and SDC, together with a Vortex VPU synthesizing to 561.67k~$μ\mathrm{m}^2$, further demonstrate specification-driven, protocol-rich, memory-rich, and hierarchical designs. In the controlled operator study, the HINT-mediated route shows better observed convergence and avoids the severe implementation-quality degradation seen in several direct-generation results.

</details>


### [440] [Hybrid ASIC-FPAA Fabric for Performance Security Trade-off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07896)
*Ziyi Chen,Vaibhav Venugopal Rao,Kyle Juretus,Ioannis Savidis*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合专用集成电路(ASIC)与现场可编程模拟阵列(FPAA)的混合架构，通过可编程晶体管对(TP)阵列对模拟电路拓扑进行混淆，在保证电路性能的同时提升安全性。实验表明，在Delta-Sigma调制器中，该方案仅牺牲<0.25%的有效位数(ENOB)和增加28.1%功耗，却实现了5倍的安全性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟电路在硬件安全方面面临性能与安全性之间的固有矛盾：传统混淆技术会显著降低电路性能，而现有方案无法在保证性能的同时提供足够的安全防护。作者旨在提出一种混合架构，在不显著牺牲性能的前提下实现高强度的电路拓扑混淆。

Method: 1) 提出ASIC-FPAA混合架构，结合ASIC的高性能和FPAA的可编程安全性；2) 开发可编程晶体管对(TP)用于在晶体管对阵列中混淆模拟电路拓扑；3) 提出虚拟晶体管对技术，进一步混淆电路活动晶体管数量；4) 开发整体拓扑混淆方法；5) 设计算法用于将大型模拟电路的子模块最优映射到FPAA结构上，权衡性能与安全性。

Result: 在Delta-Sigma调制器中将比较器模块实现在FPAA结构上，有效位数(ENOB)下降不到0.25%，功耗增加28.1%。安全性指标显示，相对未混淆的电路方案，所提技术提供了5倍的安全性提升，并已针对最新攻击方法进行了评估验证。

Conclusion: 所提出的混合架构和混淆技术在保证电路性能（性能下降可忽略不计）的同时，显著提升了模拟电路的安全性，为模拟电路IP保护提供了一种实用的解决方案。未来可扩展至更大型的模拟电路系统。

Abstract: In this paper, a hybrid architecture that combines an application specific integrated circuit (ASIC) and a field-programmable analog array (ASIC-FPAA) is proposed to address the performance-security trade-off in analog circuits. A programmable transistor pair (TP) is developed that obfuscates the topology of an analog circuit within an array of transistor pairs while minimizing the degradation in circuit performance due to the implemented security features. In addition, a technique that utilizes dummy transistor pairs is proposed that further masks the topology of a circuit by obfuscating the number of active transistors that comprise the target analog circuit. A method to obfuscate the entire topology of an analog circuit is also developed. The FPAA provides the highest-level of security robustness as the entire circuit topology is programmed onto the transistor pair array, while trading-off performance. For large analog circuits requiring multiple configurable analog blocks (CABs), an algorithm is developed that identifies and maps the sub-blocks of the circuit best suited for obfuscation on the FPAA fabric, while accounting for the trade-off between performance and security. For the delta-sigma modulator, the comparator module is selected for implementation on the FPAA fabric, which results in a reduction of less than 0.25% in the effective number of bits (ENOB) and an increase of 28.1% in the power consumption as compared to an unobfuscated delta-sigma modulator. The security robustness of the proposed techniques are evaluated against the latest attack methodologies. Results indicate that the proposed techniques provide a 5x improvement in security as measured by a developed metric without compromising performance.

</details>


### [441] [ARMOR: Accelerating RTL Simulation by Mitigating the Front-End Bottleneck Using Node Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08462)
*Jiaping Tang,Jianan Mu,Zhiteng Chao,Jingzhong Wen,Jing Ye,Huawei Li*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: ARMOR是一种通过节点压缩缓解前端瓶颈的高效RTL模拟器，利用展开RTL图中暴露的数据并行性和位空间利用率不足，将多个节点压缩为单一指令序列，在CPU设计和AI加速器上分别取得1.6x和2.7x加速比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTL模拟是芯片设计不可或缺的环节，现有高性能模拟器将RTL图中每个节点降为指令序列，虽然便于编译器优化，但代码足迹急剧膨胀超出指令缓存容量，导致前端瓶颈。剖析显示超过50%的流水线停顿由CPU前端引起，已成为先进RTL模拟器的主要性能瓶颈。完全展开RTL图与同时减小代码足迹之间存在根本矛盾。

Method: ARMOR通过节点压缩缓解前端瓶颈，核心思想是利用展开RTL图暴露的数据并行性及逐节点降级暴露的位空间利用率不足，通过位级数据并行将多个节点同时压缩，使单一指令序列服务多个节点。具体包括三个组件：(1)模块感知的同构子图识别方法，利用模块实例间的结构同构性在子图级别系统识别压缩机会；(2)对齐感知的密集打包策略，根据数据流依赖将节点分组同时保持数据重用，辅以贪心合并策略提升位空间利用率；(3)统一的位级并行方案，支持压缩节点的位级并行执行。

Result: 与最先进的模拟器相比，ARMOR在CPU设计上实现1.6倍加速，在AI加速器上实现2.7倍加速。

Conclusion: ARMOR通过位级节点压缩有效解决了RTL模拟器中代码足迹过大导致的CPU前端瓶颈问题，验证了利用位级数据并行压缩多个节点为单一指令序列的可行性，为高性能RTL仿真提供了新的优化方向。

Abstract: RTL simulation is indispensable in chip design. High-performance simulators typically lower each node in the RTL graph into an instruction sequence. Although this per-node lowering enables aggressive compiler optimizations, it dramatically increases the code footprint, severely exceeding instruction cache capacity and causing front-end bottlenecks. Our profiling reveals that over 50% of pipeline stalls are caused by the CPU front-end, becoming a key performance bottleneck in state-of-the-art RTL simulators. However, reaping the optimization benefits of fully unrolling the RTL graph while simultaneously reducing the code footprint to mitigate front-end bottlenecks remains highly challenging. In this paper, we propose ARMOR, an efficient RTL simulator designed to alleviate the front-end bottleneck through node compression. The key idea is to exploit the data parallelism exposed by the unrolling RTL graph and the insufficient bit-space utilization revealed by per-node lowering, leveraging bit-level data parallelism to compress multiple nodes simultaneously, so that a single instruction sequence can serve multiple nodes instead of one per node. To achieve profitable node compression, we first propose a module-aware isomorphic subgraph identification method that leverages structural isomorphism across module instances to systematically identify compression opportunities at the subgraph level. We then propose an alignment-aware dense packing strategy that groups nodes into packs according to dataflow dependencies while preserving data reuse, complemented by greedy merging strategies to enhance bit-space utilization. Finally, we implement a unified bit-level parallelism scheme to support bit-level parallel execution of compressed nodes. Experimental results show that ARMOR achieves 1.6x speedup on CPU designs and 2.7x speedup on AI accelerators compared to state-of-the-art simulators.

</details>


### [442] [ReVolt: Power Delivery Network-Aware Voltage Droop Control for 2.5D PIM Chiplet Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08496)
*Vibhanshu Sharma,Alish Kanani,Miao Sun,Janardhan Rao Doppa,Umit Y. Ogras,Partha Pratim Pande*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出ReVolt，一个基于动态操作单元(OU)的框架，用于缓解基于PIM的2.5D多芯粒平台中的电压跌落问题。ReVolt利用LSTM预测模型对每芯粒供电电压轨迹进行运行时预测，通过主动调整OU大小来调节芯粒级电流需求，在保持ML推理精度的同时防止电压违规并改善能量延迟积(EDP)。实验表明，与现有基线相比，ReVolt平均实现76倍EDP降低且不牺牲推理精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于PIM的2.5D多芯粒平台虽能加速机器学习工作负载，但其性能受供电网络(PDN)影响显著。芯粒级电流需求的变化会在空间和时间上引起电压跌落，导致电压违规、系统性能退化以及ML推理精度下降。因此，需要一种有效机制来主动缓解这一问题。

Method: ReVolt采用LSTM构建PDN替代模型，在运行时预测每个芯粒的供电电压轨迹。它将操作单元(OU)大小作为控制旋钮，通过动态调整OU大小来主动调节芯粒级电流需求，从而在缓解电压跌落的同时维持计算精度。这是一种前馈式的主动控制策略，而非传统的被动响应机制。

Result: 实验结果表明，ReVolt能够完全防止电压跌落违规事件的发生，在保持ML模型推理精度的前提下，与现有的固定和动态OU基线相比，平均实现了76倍的EDP（能量延迟积）改善。

Conclusion: ReVolt验证了利用LSTM代理模型进行PDN电压预测、并以OU大小作为控制手段进行动态电流调度的有效性，为PIM多芯粒系统提供了一种在不牺牲计算精度的前提下同时提升可靠性和能效的解决方案。

Abstract: Processing-in-memory (PIM)-based 2.5D multi-chiplet platforms are enablers for machine learning (ML) workloads. However, their performance is affected by the power delivery network (PDN), where varying chiplet-level current demand induces spatially and temporally varying voltage droop. These droop events lead to voltage violations, degrades system performance, and impact inference accuracy for ML workloads. In this work, we propose ReVolt, a dynamic operation unit (OU)-based framework for mitigating voltage droop in PIM-based multi-chiplet systems. ReVolt leverages an LSTM-based PDN surrogate to predict per-chiplet supply voltage trajectories at runtime, enabling proactive adjustment of OU size to mitigate droop events. By treating OU size as a control knob, ReVolt regulates chiplet-level current demand while maintaining computational accuracy. This approach prevents voltage droop violations and improves energy-delay product (EDP) while preserving ML model inference accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that ReVolt prevents voltage droop violations while achieving an average 76x reduction in EDP compared to existing fixed and dynamic OU-based baselines, without compromising inference accuracy of ML models.

</details>


### [443] [Eco-SoC: A Sustainable VLSI Architecture for Energy-Proportional Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08761)
*Jatin Chopra*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出Eco-SoC，一种面向可持续AI的高度可扩展VLSI架构，通过硬件级动态精度缩放逻辑（DPSL）根据实时激活稀疏度自适应调节位宽精度，在商用7nm FinFET工艺上降低42%开关活动，并通过生命周期评估表明仅需1.1年即抵消额外碳排放（4.8%面积开销），同时通过热感知电源门控机制将MTTF提高一倍以缓解电子垃圾问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着气候变化加剧和边缘智能的普及，半导体制造与运行的环境成本已达临界点。深度学习加速器主导SoC芯片面积，但传统静态最坏情况效率设计无法实现真正的可持续性，亟需从静态最坏情况效率转向动态能量比例（energy-proportionality）设计范式。

Method: 提出Eco-SoC架构，包含三大核心机制：(1) 硬件级动态精度缩放逻辑（DPSL）框架，依据实时激活稀疏度自适应调制位宽精度以降低开关活动；(2) 超越传统PPA指标，采用架构碳足迹工具（ACT）进行全生命周期评估（LCA）；(3) 热感知电源门控机制以缓解局部热点。架构在商业7nm FinFET工艺节点实现，与深度学习加速器协同设计。

Result: 在商用7nm FinFET工艺节点上，DPSL框架成功将开关活动降低高达42%；Eco-SoC仅引入4.8%的边际面积开销，其增加的隐含碳足迹在边缘部署后1.1年内即可被抵消；热感知电源门控机制使硅片预计平均失效时间（MTTF）翻倍。

Conclusion: Eco-SoC提供了一种可扩展的可持续AI架构策略，从动态精度缩放、全生命周期碳足迹评估和可靠性增强三个维度综合解决半导体可持续发展问题，为下一代计算系统中的电子垃圾（e-waste）缓解提供了切实可行的路径。

Abstract: In an era defined by escalating climate change and the pervasive deployment of edge intelligence, the environmental cost of semiconductor manufacturing and operation has reached a critical threshold. As Deep Learning (DL) accelerators dominate System-on-Chip (SoC) die area, achieving true sustainability requires a paradigm shift from static worst-case efficiency to dynamic energy-proportionality. This paper introduces Eco-SoC, a highly scalable VLSI architecture co-designed specifically for sustainable artificial intelligence. We propose a hardware-level Dynamic Precision-Scaling Logic (DPSL) framework that adaptively modulates bit-width precision based on real-time activation sparsity, successfully reducing switching activity by up to 42% on a commercial 7nm FinFET process node.
  Furthermore, we transcend traditional Power-Performance-Area (PPA) metrics by providing a comprehensive Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) using the Architectural Carbon footprint Tool (ACT). Our synthesis demonstrates that Eco-SoC offsets its increased embodied carbon footprint (a marginal 4.8% area overhead) within 1.1 years of edge deployment. Finally, by introducing a thermal-aware power gating mechanism that mitigates localized hotspots, Eco-SoC doubles the projected Mean Time To Failure (MTTF) of the silicon, providing a tangible, scalable strategy for electronic waste (e-waste) mitigation in next-generation computing systems.

</details>


### [444] [FSGen: Agile Fused and Sparse Accelerator Generator with Accurate Power Model for LLM Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.09252)
*Jay Zhe-An Mok,Qijun Zhang,Zhiyao Xie*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: FSGen是一个面向注意力机制大语言模型（LLM）加速器生成的敏捷框架，配备早期PPA（功耗-性能-面积）估算器，支持融合算子数据流和稀疏性，相比先前工作实现了1.4倍功耗效率提升或10倍加速，Pareto最优设计在广泛的LLM基准上表现更优，且设计空间探索更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI应用需求增长，LLM已成为多个领域的重要工作负载。然而，如何高效生成最优AI芯片加速器设计仍是一个未解决的挑战性难题，目前缺乏端到端的高效设计空间探索（DSE）方法论。

Method: 提出FSGen框架，集成早期PPA估算器实现端到端的设计空间探索，支持融合算子数据流和稀疏性，涵盖多样化的设计空间。

Result: 相比先前工作，FSGen找到的设计功耗效率提升1.4倍或性能加速10倍且PPA指标相当；Pareto最优设计在广泛的LLM基准上表现显著更优，品质因数（FoM）提升58倍；PPA估算器精度优于先前方法，大幅缩短了DSE运行时间。

Conclusion: FSGen通过端到端的敏捷框架和早期PPA估算器，有效解决了LLM加速器设计空间探索的效率和精度问题，为注意力机制LLM加速器设计提供了高效、可扩展的生成方案。

Abstract: With the growing demand of artificial intelligence (AI) applications, large language models (LLMs) have become important workloads in many domains. The question of how to efficiently generate optimal AI chip accelerator designs remains unresolved and challenging. Currently, there is a lack of end-to-end design methodologies for efficient design space exploration (DSE). We propose FSGen, an agile framework for attention-based LLM accelerator generation with an early-stage PPA estimator. FSGen supports fused operator dataflows and sparsity with a diverse design space and finds designs with 1.4x better power efficiency or 10x speedup with similar PPA metrics compared to prior work. Pareto-optimal designs have much better performance over a wide range of LLM benchmarks and have 58x better figures of merit (FoM). Design exploration is also faster due to our PPA estimators, which have better accuracy than prior art and reduce DSE runtime drastically.

</details>
